/* =====================================================================
   公众数据公示大屏（免登录）
   ===================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const { defineComponent, ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } = Vue;
  const h = App.h;

  const PageScreen = defineComponent({
    name: 'page-screen',
    setup() {
      const d = ref(null);
      const err = ref('');
      const cd = ref(30);
      let timer = null, tick = null;

      async function load() {
        try { d.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/public/dashboard', null, { noAuth: true }); err.value = ''; }
        catch (e) { err.value = e.message; }
      }

      onMounted(() => {
        load();
        timer = setInterval(load, 30000);
        tick = setInterval(() => { cd.value = cd.value <= 1 ? 30 : cd.value - 1; }, 1000);
      });
      onUnmounted(() => { clearInterval(timer); clearInterval(tick); });

      /* ---------------- 图表配置 ---------------- */
      const trendOption = computed(() => {
        if (!d.value) return null;
        const t = d.value.trend;
        return App.chartBase({
          legend: { data: ['排放总量', '排放强度'], textStyle: { color: '#8d9cb5', fontSize: 11.5 }, top: 0, right: 8 },
          grid: { left: 10, right: 30, top: 34, bottom: 6, containLabel: true },
          tooltip: Object.assign(App.chartBase().tooltip, {
            formatter: (ps) => {
              const p = ps[0];
              return `<b>${p.axisValue}</b><br/>排放总量：<b style="color:#34d399">${App.fmt.num(t[p.dataIndex].total)}</b> tCO₂e<br/>排放强度：<b style="color:#38bdf8">${t[p.dataIndex].intensity}</b> t/万元`;
            },
          }),
          xAxis: App.catAxis(t.map((x) => x.period), { boundaryGap: false }),
          yAxis: [
            App.valAxis({ name: 'tCO₂e', nameTextStyle: { color: '#5f6d85', fontSize: 10.5 } }),
            App.valAxis({ name: '强度', nameTextStyle: { color: '#5f6d85', fontSize: 10.5 }, splitLine: { show: false } }),
          ],
          series: [
            {
              name: '排放总量', type: 'line', smooth: true, symbol: 'circle', symbolSize: 6,
              data: t.map((x) => x.total), lineStyle: { width: 2.6, color: '#10b981' },
              itemStyle: { color: '#10b981' },
              areaStyle: { color: App.areaGrad('rgba(16,185,129,.42)', 'rgba(16,185,129,.02)') },
            },
            {
              name: '排放强度', type: 'line', yAxisIndex: 1, smooth: true, symbol: 'circle', symbolSize: 5,
              data: t.map((x) => x.intensity), lineStyle: { width: 2, color: '#38bdf8', type: 'dashed' },
              itemStyle: { color: '#38bdf8' },
            },
          ],
        });
      });

      const industryOption = computed(() => {
        if (!d.value) return null;
        const list = d.value.byIndustry || [];
        return App.chartBase({
          tooltip: Object.assign(App.chartBase().tooltip, { trigger: 'item', formatter: '{b}<br/>{c} tCO₂e（{d}%）' }),
          legend: { orient: 'vertical', right: 4, top: 'center', textStyle: { color: '#8d9cb5', fontSize: 11.5 } },
          series: [{
            type: 'pie', radius: ['46%', '72%'], center: ['36%', '52%'], avoidLabelOverlap: true,
            itemStyle: { borderColor: 'rgba(6,10,18,.9)', borderWidth: 2, borderRadius: 4 },
            label: { show: false }, labelLine: { show: false },
            data: list.map((x) => ({ name: x.name, value: Math.round(x.value) })),
          }],
        });
      });

      const regionOption = computed(() => {
        if (!d.value) return null;
        const list = (d.value.byRegion || []).slice(0, 10).reverse();
        return App.chartBase({
          grid: { left: 10, right: 40, top: 14, bottom: 6, containLabel: true },
          tooltip: Object.assign(App.chartBase().tooltip, { formatter: (ps) => `${ps[0].name}<br/>排放量 <b>${App.fmt.num(ps[0].value)}</b> tCO₂e` }),
          xAxis: App.valAxis({ show: false }),
          yAxis: App.catAxis(list.map((x) => x.name), { axisLabel: { color: '#8d9cb5', fontSize: 11 } }),
          series: [{
            type: 'bar', data: list.map((x) => x.value), barWidth: 11,
            itemStyle: {
              borderRadius: [0, 6, 6, 0],
              color: new echarts.graphic.LinearGradient(0, 0, 1, 0, [
                { offset: 0, color: 'rgba(16,185,129,.35)' }, { offset: 1, color: '#34d399' },
              ]),
            },
            label: { show: true, position: 'right', color: '#8d9cb5', fontSize: 10.5, formatter: (p) => App.fmt.big(p.value) },
          }],
        });
      });

      const priceOption = computed(() => {
        if (!d.value) return null;
        const t = d.value.priceTrend || [];
        return App.chartBase({
          grid: { left: 10, right: 16, top: 22, bottom: 6, containLabel: true },
          tooltip: Object.assign(App.chartBase().tooltip, {
            formatter: (ps) => `${ps[0].axisValue}<br/>均价 <b style="color:#fbbf24">${ps[0].value}</b> 元/吨<br/>成交 ${App.fmt.num(t[ps[0].dataIndex].volume)} 吨`,
          }),
          xAxis: App.catAxis(t.map((x) => x.month), { boundaryGap: false }),
          yAxis: App.valAxis({ scale: true, name: '元/吨', nameTextStyle: { color: '#5f6d85', fontSize: 10.5 } }),
          series: [{
            type: 'line', smooth: true, data: t.map((x) => x.price), symbol: 'circle', symbolSize: 6,
            lineStyle: { width: 2.6, color: '#f5a524' }, itemStyle: { color: '#fbbf24' },
            areaStyle: { color: App.areaGrad('rgba(245,165,36,.4)', 'rgba(245,165,36,.02)') },
          }],
        });
      });

      /* ---------------- 渲染 ---------------- */
      return () => {
        if (err.value) {
          return h('div', { class: 'screen' }, [
            h('div', { class: 'alertbar err' }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'alert', size: 16 }),
              h('div', {}, ['数据加载失败：' + err.value, h('div', { class: 'tiny mt-8' }, '请确认后端服务已启动（npm start）且数据库已初始化（npm run initdb）。')])]),
            h('div', { class: 'mt-16 flex gap-8' }, [
              h('button', { class: 'btn', onClick: load }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'refresh', size: 15 }), '重新加载']),
              h('button', { class: 'btn primary', onClick: () => App.go('/login') }, '前往登录'),
            ]),
          ]);
        }
        if (!d.value) return h('div', { class: 'screen' }, [h('div', { class: 'skel', style: 'height:520px' })]);

        const k = d.value.kpi, c = d.value.chain;

        return h('div', { class: 'screen' }, [
          /* 头部 */
          h('div', { class: 'screen-head' }, [
            h('div', { class: 'brand-logo', style: 'width:56px;height:29px' }, [h('img', { src: './img/logo-mark.png', alt: '碳链通 CarbonChain Hub' })]),
            h('div', {}, [
              h('h1', {}, '碳链通 · 全国碳排放数据公示大屏'),
              h('div', { class: 'sub' }, '数据来源：企业自主申报 + 第三方核查机构核证 + 区块链存证 · 面向社会公众开放查询'),
            ]),
            h('div', { class: 'flex gap-8', style: 'margin-left:auto' }, [
              h('span', { class: 'chip live' }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'chain', size: 14 }), `链高度 ${c.height}`]),
              h('span', { class: 'chip' }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'clock', size: 14 }), `刷新倒计时 ${cd.value}s`]),
              h('button', { class: 'btn sm', onClick: () => App.go('/explorer') }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'block', size: 14 }), '浏览器']),
              h('button', { class: 'btn sm primary', onClick: () => App.go('/login') }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'lock', size: 14 }), '登录']),
            ]),
          ]),

          /* 行情条 */
          h('div', { class: 'ticker mb-16' }, [
            h('div', { class: 'tick' }, ['碳配额最新价 ', h('b', {}, k.lastPrice ? k.lastPrice.toFixed(2) : '-'), h('span', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '元/吨')]),
            h('div', { class: 'tick' }, ['加权均价 ', h('b', {}, k.avgPrice ? k.avgPrice.toFixed(2) : '-')]),
            h('div', { class: 'tick' }, ['累计成交 ', h('b', {}, App.fmt.big(k.tradeVolume)), h('span', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '吨')]),
            h('div', { class: 'tick' }, ['成交金额 ', h('b', {}, App.fmt.big(k.turnover)), h('span', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '元')]),
            h('div', { class: 'tick' }, ['控排企业 ', h('b', {}, k.entCount), h('span', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '家')]),
            h('div', { class: 'tick' }, ['覆盖省份 ', h('b', {}, k.regionCount)]),
            h('div', { class: 'tick', style: 'margin-left:auto' }, ['链上存证 ', h('b', {}, App.fmt.num(c.totalTxs)), h('span', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '笔 · ' + (c.difficulty ? 'PoW 难度 ' + c.difficulty : 'PoA 共识'))]),
          ]),

          /* KPI */
          h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
            h('x-kpi', { label: '本年度排放总量', value: App.fmt.num(k.emissionYtd), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'fire', tone: 'carbon', foot: `已纳入 ${k.reportCount} 份上报单` }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '核查通过率', value: k.verifiedRate, unit: '%', icon: 'shield', tone: 'sky', foot: '第三方机构核证结论' }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '区块高度', value: App.fmt.num(c.height), icon: 'block', tone: 'chain', foot: `${c.totalBlocks} 个区块 · 平均出块 ${c.avgMineTime ? c.avgMineTime + 'ms' : '—'}` }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '累计交易额', value: App.fmt.big(k.turnover), unit: '元', icon: 'trade', tone: 'violet', foot: `${App.fmt.num(k.dealCount)} 笔成交` }),
          ]),

          /* 主图区 */
          h('div', { class: 'grid g-3-2 mb-16' }, [
            h('x-card', { title: '碳排放总量与强度趋势', sub: '按报告期汇总 · 单位 tCO₂e 与 tCO₂e/万元' }, {
              default: () => h('x-chart', { option: trendOption.value, height: 'h300' }),
            }),
            h('x-card', { title: '行业排放结构', sub: '按国民经济行业分类' }, {
              default: () => h('x-chart', { option: industryOption.value, height: 'h300' }),
            }),
          ]),

          h('div', { class: 'grid g-1-2 mb-16' }, [
            h('x-card', { title: '区域排放 TOP10', sub: '按省级行政区' }, {
              default: () => h('x-chart', { option: regionOption.value, height: 'h340' }),
            }),
            h('x-card', { title: '碳配额成交价格走势', sub: '月度加权均价' }, {
              default: () => h('x-chart', { option: priceOption.value, height: 'h340' }),
            }),
          ]),

          /* 链上实时 */
          h('div', { class: 'grid g-2-1' }, [
            h('x-card', { title: '最新区块', sub: '实时出块记录 · 点击查看区块详情', flush: true }, {
              actions: () => h('button', { class: 'btn sm ghost', onClick: load }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'refresh', size: 13 }), '刷新']),
              default: () => h('div', { class: 'card-body' }, [
                h('div', { class: 'blockfeed' }, d.value.latestBlocks.map((b) => h('div', {
                  class: 'bf-item', style: 'cursor:pointer',
                  onClick: () => App.go('/explorer/block/' + b.block_index),
                }, [
                  h('div', { class: 'bf-idx' }, '#' + b.block_index),
                  h('div', { class: 'bf-main' }, [
                    h('div', { class: 'bf-hash' }, [h('x-hash', { value: b.block_hash, len: 18 })]),
                    h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mt-8' }, `父哈希 ${App.fmt.short(b.prev_hash, 10)}`),
                  ]),
                  h('div', { class: 'col right gap-4', style: 'align-items:flex-end' }, [
                    h('span', { class: 'tag t-chain', style: 'font-size:11.4px' }, `${b.tx_count} 笔`),
                    h('span', { class: 'tiny dim' }, App.fmt.ago(b.block_time)),
                  ]),
                ]))),
              ]),
            }),
            h('div', { class: 'col gap-16' }, [
              h('x-card', { title: '链上存证构成' }, {
                default: () => h('div', {}, [
                  h('x-bars', {
                    items: c.byBizType.map((x) => ({
                      name: ({ EMISSION_REPORT: '排放上报', VERIFY_REPORT: '核查报告', QUOTA_ALLOC: '配额分配', TRADE_DEAL: '交易成交', ENTERPRISE_REG: '企业备案' })[x.tx_type] || x.tx_type,
                      value: x.cnt,
                    })),
                    format: (v) => App.fmt.num(v) + ' 笔',
                  }),
                  h('div', { class: 'flex gap-12 wrap mt-16' }, [
                    h('span', { class: 'tag t-ok' }, 'SHA-256'),
                    h('span', { class: 'tag t-info' }, 'secp256k1 ECDSA'),
                    h('span', { class: 'tag t-chain' }, 'Merkle Tree'),
                    h('span', { class: 'tag t-violet' }, 'PoW 难度 ' + c.difficulty),
                  ]),
                ]),
              }),
              h('x-card', { title: '政策与市场公告' }, {
                default: () => h('div', { class: 'col gap-12' }, d.value.notices.map((n) => h('div', {
                  class: 'flex gap-8', style: 'cursor:pointer;align-items:flex-start',
                  onClick: () => App.go('/notice/' + n.id),
                }, [
                  h('x-tag', { dict: App.DICT.noticeType, dictKey: n.notice_type }),
                  h('div', { class: 'flex-1' }, [
                    h('div', { style: 'font-size:12.8px;color:var(--tx-1)' }, n.title),
                    h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, `${n.publisher} · ${App.fmt.d(n.publish_time)}`),
                  ]),
                ]))),
              }),
            ]),
          ]),
        ]);
      };
    },
  });

  App.views = App.views || {};
  App.views['page-screen'] = PageScreen;
})();

/* ================================================================
 * 文件：public/js/views/dynamic.js
 * ================================================================ */
/* =====================================================================
   碳资产动态核算 · 工业级闭环
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   ① 工业源端感知：边缘设备 DID / TEE·SE 硬件签名 / 物料平衡校验与风险阻断
   ② 动态核算引擎：ISO 14064 组织碳 · ISO 14067 产品碳足迹（PCF）双轨，
      电网排放因子预言机每小时同步，工序级 BOM 碳分摊
   ③ 原有能力保留：CEMS 实时读数 / 滚动核算 / 配额缺口与履约风险预警
   ===================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const { defineComponent, ref, reactive, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } = Vue;
  const h = App.h;

  const RISK_CN = { HIGH: '高风险', MEDIUM: '中风险', LOW: '低风险' };
  const riskTag = (r) => (r === 'HIGH' ? 'err' : r === 'MEDIUM' ? 'warn' : 'ok');

  const BAL_CN = { NORMAL: '正常', WATCH: '关注', ANOMALY: '异常' };
  const BAL_TAG = { NORMAL: 'ok', WATCH: 'warn', ANOMALY: 'err' };

  /** 脉冲呼吸指示灯 */
  function lamp(status, size) {
    return h('i', { class: ['ind-lamp', status], style: `width:${size || 8}px;height:${size || 8}px` });
  }

  /* CEMS 读数展示名 */
  const READOUT_LABEL = {
    powerKwh: ['有功功率', 'kWh/h'], gasNm3: ['瞬时流量', 'Nm³/h'],
    steamT: ['蒸汽流量', 't/h'], flowTh: ['投料量', 't/h'],
    o2Pct: ['烟气含氧量', '%'], so2Mg: ['SO₂ 浓度', 'mg/m³'],
    noxMg: ['NOx 浓度', 'mg/m³'], flueTempC: ['排烟温度', '℃'],
  };

  const PageDynamic = defineComponent({
    name: 'page-dynamic',
    setup() {
      const ov = ref(null);
      const readings = ref(null);
      const busy = ref(false);
      const isEnt = computed(() => App.Store.user && App.Store.user.role === 'ENTERPRISE');
      const entId = computed(() => (isEnt.value && App.Store.user ? Number(App.Store.user.orgId) : null));

      /* 实时脉动：每 2.4s 微调一次工况读数，营造真实在线监测观感 */
      const tick = ref(0);
      let timer = null;
      onMounted(() => { timer = setInterval(() => { tick.value++; }, 2400); });
      onUnmounted(() => { clearInterval(timer); });

      /* ── 双轨核算标准切换 ── */
      const track = ref('ORG');

      /* ── 工序级 BOM：当前选中批次 ── */
      const batchNo = ref(null);

      /* ── 由数据域派生的视图数据 ── */
      const devices = computed(() => App.Industry.devicesOf(entId.value));
      const batches = computed(() => App.Industry.batchesOf(entId.value));
      const balance = computed(() => App.Industry.balanceOf(entId.value));
      const oracle = App.Industry.oracle;

      const onlineCount = computed(() => devices.value.filter((d) => d.online).length);
      const sealedCount = computed(() => devices.value.length);
      const teeCount = computed(() => devices.value.filter((d) => d.chip === 'TEE').length);
      const blockedBatches = computed(() => batches.value.filter((b) => b.status === 'BLOCKED'));

      /** 当前选中批次对象 */
      const curBatch = computed(() => {
        const list = batches.value;
        if (!list.length) return null;
        return list.find((b) => b.batchNo === batchNo.value) || list[0];
      });

      /** 工况读数（叠加 tick 抖动） */
      function liveOf(d) {
        const t = tick.value + (d.did.length % 7);
        const j = (Math.sin(t * 0.9) + 1) / 2;   // 0..1
        const L = d.live;
        const out = {};
        Object.keys(READOUT_LABEL).forEach((k) => {
          if (L[k] === null || L[k] === undefined) { out[k] = null; return; }
          const amp = k === 'o2Pct' ? 0.06 : k === 'flowTh' ? 0.04 : 0.012;
          out[k] = +(L[k] * (1 + (j - 0.5) * amp * 2)).toFixed(k === 'o2Pct' || k === 'flowTh' ? 2 : 0);
        });
        out.signal = L.signal;
        out.latencyMs = L.latencyMs;
        return out;
      }

      /* ── 后端真实数据（保留原有能力） ── */
      async function load() {
        try {
          ov.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/dynamic/overview');
          if (isEnt.value) {
            try { readings.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/dynamic/readings', null); }
            catch (e) { readings.value = null; }
          }
        } catch (e) { App.notify.err(e.message); }
      }
      onMounted(load);

      async function run(path, body, okMsg) {
        busy.value = true;
        try { const r = await App.API.request('POST', path, body || {}); App.notify.ok(typeof okMsg === 'function' ? okMsg(r) : okMsg); await load(); }
        catch (e) { App.notify.err(e.message); } finally { busy.value = false; }
      }
      const doIngest = () => run('/dynamic/ingest', { days: 1 }, (r) => `已采集 ${r.inserted} 条 CEMS 实测读数`);
      const doRecompute = () => run('/dynamic/recompute', {}, (r) => `已完成 ${r.count} 家企业的滚动核算`);

      /* 预言机倒计时 */
      const oracleCountdown = computed(() => {
        tick.value; // 依赖 tick 触发刷新
        const ms = Math.max(0, oracle.nextSync - Date.now());
        const m = Math.floor(ms / 60000), s = Math.floor((ms % 60000) / 1000);
        return String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
      });

      return () => {
        const d = ov.value || { summary: {}, readings: {}, accounts: [] };
        const s = d.summary || {};
        const r = d.readings || {};
        const bal = balance.value || { ratio: 0, status: 'NORMAL', items: [] };
        const scoped = isEnt.value ? '本企业' : '全部纳入企业';

        return h('x-page', {
          title: '碳资产动态核算',
          desc: '区别于按季度人工填报：本页数据来自工业源端边缘设备（智能电表 / 天然气计量表 / 蒸汽流量计 / CEMS 烟气分析仪）的在线监测，在边缘侧完成国密签名与物料平衡校验后上链，由智能合约按 ISO 14064 组织碳与 ISO 14067 产品碳足迹双轨标准、结合每小时同步的动态电网排放因子自动折算，并滚动预测配额缺口与履约风险。',
        }, {
          actions: () => [
            h('button', { class: 'btn sm', disabled: busy.value, onClick: doIngest }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'refresh', size: 14 }), '采集一批实测数据']),
            h('button', { class: 'btn sm chain', disabled: busy.value, onClick: doRecompute }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'chart', size: 14 }), '立即滚动核算']),
          ],
          default: () => [
            /* ============================ KPI ============================ */
            h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
              h('x-kpi', { label: '核算周期', value: d.period || '-', icon: 'clock', tone: 'violet', foot: '滚动核算·非季度填报' }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '覆盖企业', value: App.fmt.num(s.enterprises || 0), unit: '家', icon: 'factory', tone: 'carbon', foot: '纳入动态核算' }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '接入边缘设备', value: onlineCount.value + '/' + devices.value.length, icon: 'layers', tone: 'sky', foot: `TEE 安全芯片 ${teeCount.value} 台 · 全部签名固化` }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '物料平衡度', value: bal.worstRatio.toFixed(1), unit: '%', icon: 'target', tone: bal.status === 'ANOMALY' ? 'rose' : bal.status === 'WATCH' ? 'violet' : 'chain', foot: BAL_CN[bal.status] + ' · 低于 95% 自动阻断上链' }),
            ]),
            h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
              h('x-kpi', { label: '实测读数', value: App.fmt.num(r.total || 0), unit: '条', icon: 'db', tone: 'sky', foot: (r.lastAt ? '最新 ' + App.fmt.dt(r.lastAt) : '等待采数') }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '年度累计排放', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(s.cumulativeEmission || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'leaf', tone: 'chain', foot: '实测累计' }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '预计配额缺口', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(s.totalGap || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'target', tone: (s.totalGap > 0 ? 'rose' : 'chain'), foot: s.totalGap > 0 ? '整体预计超排' : '整体预计盈余' }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '在库产品批次', value: batches.value.length, unit: '批', icon: 'block', tone: 'carbon', foot: blockedBatches.value.length ? `${blockedBatches.value.length} 批因物料平衡异常被阻断` : '全部批次上链正常' }),
            ]),

            /* ==================================================================
               模块 1 · 工业源端感知与设备 DID
               ================================================================== */
            h('div', { class: 'sect-head' }, [
              h('span', { class: 'no' }, '01'),
              h('div', {}, [
                h('h3', {}, '工业源端感知与边缘设备可信身份（Device DID）'),
                h('p', {}, '每一台计量/监测设备在出厂即写入唯一去中心化身份 DID，报文中携带硬件指纹与国密签名。链上只认「已固化签名的边缘报文」，人工录入无法伪造源头。'),
              ]),
            ]),

            h('div', { class: 'grid g-2-1 mb-16' }, [
              h('x-card', { title: '边缘采集设备可信状态', sub: scoped + ' · ' + devices.value.length + ' 台在线设备，全部为 TEE / SE 硬件级签名', class: 'mb-0' }, {
                default: () => h('div', { class: 'tbl-wrap', style: 'max-height:430px;overflow:auto' }, [
                  h('table', { class: 'tbl' }, [
                    h('thead', {}, h('tr', {}, ['设备 DID', '设备类型', '安装点位', '通信协议', '安全芯片 / 算法', '物料平衡', '状态', '实时工况'].map((t) => h('th', {}, t)))),
                    h('tbody', {}, devices.value.map((dv) => {
                      const L = liveOf(dv);
                      const kv = Object.keys(READOUT_LABEL).filter((k) => L[k] !== null);
                      return h('tr', {}, [
                        h('td', {}, [
                          h('div', { class: 'did mono', title: '点击复制 DID', onClick: () => App.copyText(dv.did) }, dv.did),
                          h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mono' }, 'FP ' + dv.hwFingerprint.slice(0, 17) + '…'),
                        ]),
                        h('td', {}, [
                          h('div', { style: 'font-size:12.6px;color:var(--tx-0)' }, dv.kindCn),
                          h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, dv.entShort + ' · ' + dv.industry),
                        ]),
                        h('td', { class: 'tiny' }, dv.site),
                        h('td', {}, h('span', { class: 'proto' }, dv.protocol)),
                        h('td', {}, [
                          h('div', { class: 'tiny', style: 'color:var(--tx-0)' }, (dv.chip === 'TEE' ? '🔒 ' : '🔐 ') + dv.chip + ' · ' + dv.alg),
                          h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '固件 ' + dv.fw + ' · 签名已固化'),
                        ]),
                        h('td', {}, [
                          h('div', { class: 'flex gap-6', style: 'align-items:center' }, [
                            lamp(dv.balance.status, 7),
                            h('b', { class: 'mono', style: 'font-size:12.6px;color:' + (dv.balance.status === 'NORMAL' ? 'var(--chain-l)' : dv.balance.status === 'WATCH' ? '#fcd34d' : '#fda4af') },
                              dv.balance.ratio.toFixed(1) + '%'),
                          ]),
                          h('div', { class: 'tiny dim', title: dv.balance.note }, BAL_CN[dv.balance.status]),
                        ]),
                        h('td', {}, h('span', { class: ['tag', dv.status === 'ONLINE' ? 'ok' : 'err'] }, dv.status === 'ONLINE' ? '在线' : '异常')),
                        h('td', {}, kv.slice(0, 3).map((k) => h('div', { class: 'tiny mono', style: 'white-space:nowrap' },
                          READOUT_LABEL[k][0] + ' ' + App.fmt.num(L[k]) + ' ' + READOUT_LABEL[k][1]))),
                      ]);
                    })),
                  ]),
                ]),
              }),

              h('div', { class: 'col gap-16' }, [
                /* 物料平衡校验指示灯 */
                h('x-card', { title: '物料平衡校验', sub: '边缘侧自动比对「能耗工况」与「产量/物料投入」的理论平衡度' }, {
                  default: () => h('div', {}, [
                    h('div', { class: ['bal-meter', bal.status] }, [
                      lamp(bal.status, 12),
                      h('div', { class: 'flex-1' }, [
                        h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '耗电工况与产量比对平衡度'),
                        h('div', { class: 'bal-val mono' }, bal.worstRatio.toFixed(1) + '%'),
                      ]),
                      h('span', { class: ['tag', BAL_TAG[bal.status]] }, BAL_CN[bal.status]),
                    ]),
                    h('div', { class: ['alertbar', bal.status === 'ANOMALY' ? 'stop' : bal.status === 'WATCH' ? 'warn' : 'ok', 'mt-12'] }, [
                      h('x-icon', { name: bal.status === 'NORMAL' ? 'check' : 'alert', size: 15 }),
                      bal.status === 'ANOMALY' && h('b', { style: 'flex:0 0 auto' }, '风控阻断'),
                      bal.status === 'ANOMALY'
                        ? `检测到 ${bal.items.filter((i) => i.status === 'ANOMALY').length} 台设备平衡度低于 95% 阈值，该设备的批次数据已自动阻断上链，须人工核查能源计量台账后方可重放。`
                        : bal.status === 'WATCH'
                          ? '存在设备平衡度接近阈值（95%~99%），已标记关注并提高采数频次，暂不影响上链。'
                          : '全部设备平衡度正常，源端数据已通过完整性交叉校验，可直接进入核算与上链流程。',
                    ]),
                    h('div', { class: 'col gap-8 mt-12' }, bal.items.map((i) => h('div', { class: 'bal-row' }, [
                      h('span', { class: 'nm mono', title: i.did }, i.did.replace('did:', '')),
                      h('div', { class: 'bar-track' }, [
                        h('div', { class: ['bar-fill', i.status === 'ANOMALY' ? 'danger' : i.status === 'WATCH' ? 'warn' : ''], style: `width:${i.ratio}%` }),
                      ]),
                      h('span', { class: 'vv mono' }, i.ratio.toFixed(1) + '%'),
                    ]))),
                  ]),
                }),

                /* 边缘报文与签名 */
                h('x-card', { title: '边缘报文与硬件签名', sub: '最新一条上报帧 · 签名在 TEE 内部完成，CPU 侧无法读取私钥' }, {
                  default: () => {
                    const d0 = devices.value[0];
                    if (!d0) return h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '暂无设备');
                    return h('div', {}, [
                      h('dl', { class: 'kv', style: 'grid-template-columns:88px 1fr' }, [
                        h('dt', {}, '设备'), h('dd', { class: 'mono' }, d0.did),
                        h('dt', {}, '安全芯片'), h('dd', {}, d0.chipCn + ' · ' + d0.alg),
                        h('dt', {}, '签名固化'), h('dd', {}, h('span', { class: 'tag ok' }, '边缘硬件签名已固化')),
                        h('dt', {}, '防篡改'), h('dd', {}, h('span', { class: 'tag chain' }, '报文物理哈希防篡改')),
                        h('dt', {}, '报文长度'), h('dd', { class: 'mono' }, d0.frameLen + ' 字节'),
                        h('dt', {}, '上报时间'), h('dd', { class: 'mono' }, App.fmt.ago(d0.rptAt)),
                      ]),
                      h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mt-12 mb-8' }, '原始十六进制报文（物理层，未加工）'),
                      h('pre', { class: 'mono-pre frame-pre' }, d0.frame),
                      h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mt-8' }, '国密 SM2 签名值'),
                      h('div', { class: 'hashbox', style: 'margin-top:6px' }, d0.teeSignature),
                    ]);
                  },
                }),
              ]),
            ]),

            /* ==================================================================
               模块 2 · 动态核算引擎与智能合约体系
               ================================================================== */
            h('div', { class: 'sect-head' }, [
              h('span', { class: 'no' }, '02'),
              h('div', {}, [
                h('h3', {}, '动态核算引擎与智能合约体系'),
                h('p', {}, '核算规则以智能合约形式固化在链上：双轨标准可切换、排放因子由预言机每小时同步、工序级 BOM 自动分摊。规则透明、可审计、不可被单方修改。'),
              ]),
            ]),

            h('x-card', { class: 'mb-16' }, {
              head: () => h('div', { class: 'seg' }, [

                    h('td', { class: 'mono', style: a.gap > 0 ? 'color:var(--danger,#e5484d)' : '' }, (a.gap > 0 ? '+' : '') + App.fmt.num(Math.round(a.gap))),
                    h('td', { class: 'mono' }, App.fmt.num(Math.round(a.predictedEoy))),
                    h('td', {}, h('span', { class: ['tag', riskTag(a.riskLevel)] }, RISK_CN[a.riskLevel] || a.riskLevel)),
                    h('td', { class: 'tiny dim' }, a.lastReadingAt ? App.fmt.dt(a.lastReadingAt) : '-'),
                  ]))),
                ]),
              ]),
            }),
          ],
        });
      };
    },
  });

  App.views['page-dynamic'] = PageDynamic;
})();

/* =====================================================================
   碳资产 · 碳信用与抵销
   企业端：我的碳信用资产 / 抵销履约缺口 / 抵销记录
   监管端：全市场碳信用资产总览 / 类型分布 / 抵销流水
   ===================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const { defineComponent, ref, computed, onMounted } = Vue;
  const h = App.h;

  const PageCredit = defineComponent({
    name: 'page-credit',
    setup() {
      const summary = ref(null);
      const assets = ref([]);
      const offsets = ref([]);
      const status = ref(null);
      const busy = ref(false);
      const isEnt = computed(() => App.Store.user && App.Store.user.role === 'ENTERPRISE');

      const modal = ref(false);
      const form = ref({ assetId: null, amount: '' });
      const pick = ref(null);

      async function load() {
        try {
          summary.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/credit/summary');
          assets.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/credit/assets');
          offsets.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/credit/offsets', null);
          if (isEnt.value) status.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/credit/status');
        } catch (e) { App.notify.err(e.message); }
      }
      onMounted(load);

      function openOffset(a) {
        const avail = a.remaining;
        const allowed = status.value ? Math.min(avail, status.value.offsetLimitRemaining) : avail;
        pick.value = a;
        form.value = { assetId: a.id, amount: String(Math.max(0, Math.floor(allowed))) };
        modal.value = true;
      }

      async function submitOffset() {
        busy.value = true;
        try {
          const r = await App.API.request('POST', '/credit/offset', {
            assetId: form.value.assetId, amount: Number(form.value.amount),
          });
          App.notify.ok(`已抵销 ${r.amount} tCO₂e，预计缺口降至 ${r.quotaAfter} tCO₂e（已上链）`);
          modal.value = false;
          await load();
        } catch (e) { App.notify.err(e.message); } finally { busy.value = false; }
      }

      const statusTag = (s) => (s === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ok' : s === 'USED' ? 'warn' : 'err');
      const statusCn = (s) => ({ ACTIVE: '可用', USED: '已用尽', EXPIRED: '已过期' }[s] || s);

      const assetTable = () => h('div', { class: 'table-wrap' }, [
        h('table', { class: 'table' }, [
          h('thead', {}, h('tr', {}, [
            ...(isEnt.value ? [] : ['持有企业']),
            '资产编号', '类型', '减排项目', '持有量', '已抵销', '可用', '签发年度', '有效期', '状态',
            ...(isEnt.value ? ['操作'] : []),
          ].map((t) => h('th', {}, t)))),
          h('tbody', {}, (assets.value || []).map((a) => h('tr', {}, [
            ...(isEnt.value ? [] : [h('td', {}, a.entName || ('企业#' + a.entId))]),
            h('td', { class: 'mono', style: 'font-size:12px' }, a.assetNo),
            h('td', {}, h('span', { class: 'tag chain' }, a.assetTypeCn)),
            h('td', {}, a.projectName || '-'),
            h('td', { class: 'mono' }, App.fmt.num(Math.round(a.amount))),
            h('td', { class: 'mono' }, App.fmt.num(Math.round(a.usedAmount))),
            h('td', { class: 'mono' }, App.fmt.num(Math.round(a.remaining))),
            h('td', { class: 'mono' }, String(a.issueYear || '-')),
            h('td', { class: 'tiny dim' }, a.validUntil ? App.fmt.dt(a.validUntil).slice(0, 10) : '-'),
            h('td', {}, h('span', { class: ['tag', statusTag(a.status)] }, statusCn(a.status))),
            ...(isEnt.value ? [h('td', {}, a.status === 'ACTIVE' && a.remaining > 0
              ? h('button', { class: 'btn xs chain', disabled: busy.value, onClick: () => openOffset(a) }, '抵销')
              : h('span', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '—'))] : []),
          ]))),
        ]),
      ]);

      const offsetTable = () => h('div', { class: 'table-wrap' }, [
        h('table', { class: 'table' }, [
          h('thead', {}, h('tr', {}, [
            ...(isEnt.value ? [] : ['企业']),
            '抵销单号', '年度', '碳信用资产', '抵销量(tCO₂e)', '抵销前缺口', '抵销后缺口', '经办人', '存证', '时间',
          ].map((t) => h('th', {}, t)))),
          h('tbody', {}, (offsets.value || []).map((o) => h('tr', {}, [
            ...(isEnt.value ? [] : [h('td', {}, o.entName)]),
            h('td', { class: 'mono', style: 'font-size:12px' }, o.offsetNo),
            h('td', { class: 'mono' }, String(o.year)),
            h('td', {}, [h('div', {}, o.assetTypeCn), h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mono' }, o.assetNo)]),
            h('td', { class: 'mono' }, App.fmt.num(Math.round(o.amount))),
            h('td', { class: 'mono' }, App.fmt.num(Math.round(o.quotaBefore))),
            h('td', { class: 'mono' }, App.fmt.num(Math.round(o.quotaAfter))),
            h('td', {}, o.operator || '-'),
            h('td', {}, o.chainTxId ? h('span', { class: 'tag ok' }, '已上链') : h('span', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '-')),
            h('td', { class: 'tiny dim' }, o.createdAt ? App.fmt.dt(o.createdAt) : '-'),
          ]))),
        ]),
      ]);

      return () => {
        const s = summary.value || { byType: [] };
        const st = status.value || {};
        const kpis = isEnt.value
          ? [
            h('x-kpi', { label: '可用碳信用', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(st.availableCredit || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'leaf', tone: 'chain', foot: 'CCER / 碳汇 / 绿证' }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '年度配额', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(st.quota || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'target', tone: 'sky', foot: '碳配额资产' }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '抵销额度上限', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(st.limit || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'shield', tone: 'violet', foot: '配额 × 5%' }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '剩余可抵销', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(st.offsetLimitRemaining || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'chart', tone: 'carbon', foot: `已抵销 ${App.fmt.num(Math.round(st.used || 0))}` }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '当前预计缺口', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(st.gap || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'alert', tone: (st.gap > 0 ? 'rose' : 'chain'), foot: '动态核算净缺口' }),
          ]
          : [
            h('x-kpi', { label: '碳信用资产总量', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(s.totalAmount || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'leaf', tone: 'chain', foot: `持有企业 ${s.holders || 0} 家` }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '已抵销', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(s.usedAmount || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'target', tone: 'carbon', foot: `抵销笔数 ${s.offsetCount || 0}` }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '可用余额', value: App.fmt.num(Math.round(s.availableAmount || 0)), unit: 'tCO₂e', icon: 'db', tone: 'sky', foot: '尚未使用' }),
            h('x-kpi', { label: '资产笔数', value: App.fmt.num(s.assetCount || 0), unit: '笔', icon: 'sheet', tone: 'violet', foot: '配额之外的第二类碳资产' }),
          ];

        return h('x-page', {
          title: isEnt.value ? '碳信用与抵销' : '碳资产总览（碳信用）',
          desc: '本平台的"碳资产"包含两类：① 碳配额（年度分配，可市场交易）；② 碳信用（国家核证自愿减排量 CCER / 林业碳汇 / 绿证）。企业可用碳信用抵销履约缺口，抵销比例不得超过配额的 5%，抵销流水上链存证。',
        }, {
          actions: () => [h('button', { class: 'btn sm', onClick: load }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'refresh', size: 14 }), '刷新'])],
          default: () => [
            h('div', { class: isEnt.value ? 'grid g5 mb-16' : 'grid g4 mb-16' }, kpis),

            !isEnt.value
              ? h('x-card', { title: '碳资产类型分布', sub: '按碳信用类型统计持有量与已抵销量', class: 'mb-16' }, {
                default: () => h('div', { class: 'col gap-10' }, (s.byType || []).length
                  ? (s.byType || []).map((t) => h('div', { class: 'flex between', style: 'align-items:center' }, [
                    h('span', {}, [h('span', { class: 'tag chain' }, t.typeCn), `　${t.count} 笔`]),
                    h('span', { class: 'mono' }, `持有 ${App.fmt.num(Math.round(t.amount))} · 已抵销 ${App.fmt.num(Math.round(t.used))} tCO₂e`),
                  ]))
                  : h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '暂无数据')),
              })
              : null,

            isEnt.value && st.gap > 0
              ? h('div', { class: ['alertbar', 'warn', 'mb-16'] }, [
                h('x-icon', { name: 'alert', size: 16 }),
                `按当前滚动核算，你企业本年度预计履约缺口约 ${App.fmt.num(Math.round(st.gap))} tCO₂e。可使用碳信用抵销（上限 ${App.fmt.num(Math.round(st.limit))} tCO₂e），或通过碳配额市场购碳履约。`,
              ])
              : null,

            h('x-card', { title: isEnt.value ? '我的碳信用资产' : '全市场碳信用资产', sub: isEnt.value ? '点击"抵销"用碳信用履约' : '按持有企业展示', class: 'mb-16' }, { default: assetTable }),

            h('x-card', { title: isEnt.value ? '我的抵销记录' : '碳信用抵销流水', sub: '每笔抵销均已上链存证' }, { default: offsetTable }),

            h('x-modal', {
              modelValue: modal.value, title: '发起碳信用抵销', width: '480px',
              'onUpdate:modelValue': (v) => { modal.value = v; },
            }, {
              default: () => [
                h('div', { class: 'col gap-10' }, [
                  h('div', { class: 'field', style: 'margin:0' }, [h('label', {}, '碳信用资产'), h('input', { class: 'input', value: pick.value ? `${pick.value.assetTypeCn} ${pick.value.assetNo}（可用 ${App.fmt.num(Math.round(pick.value.remaining))}）` : '', disabled: true })]),
                  h('div', { class: 'field', style: 'margin:0' }, [h('label', {}, '抵销量 (tCO₂e)'), h('input', { class: 'input', type: 'number', value: form.value.amount, onInput: (e) => { form.value.amount = e.target.value; } })]),
                  h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, `本次最多可抵销 ${status.value ? App.fmt.num(Math.round(Math.min(pick.value ? pick.value.remaining : 0, status.value.offsetLimitRemaining))) : '-'} tCO₂e（受配额 5% 上限与资产余额双重约束）。`),
                ]),
              ],
              footer: () => [
                h('button', { class: 'btn', onClick: () => { modal.value = false; } }, '取消'),
                h('button', { class: 'btn chain', disabled: busy.value || !(Number(form.value.amount) > 0), onClick: submitOffset }, '确认抵销并上链'),
              ],
            }),
          ],
        });
      };
    },
  });

  App.views['page-credit'] = PageCredit;
})();

/* ================================================================
 * 文件：public/js/views/consortium.js
 * ================================================================ */
/* =====================================================================
   联盟链治理：节点网络共识拓扑 / 成员节点 / 准入白名单 / 副本同步与一致性
   ===================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const { defineComponent, ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } = Vue;
  const h = App.h;

  const PageConsortium = defineComponent({
    name: 'page-consortium',
    setup() {
      const nodes = ref([]);
      const replica = ref(null);
      const busy = ref(false);
      const form = ref({ nodeId: '', nodeName: '', orgType: 'ENTERPRISE', orgName: '' });
      const ORG_TYPES = [
        ['REGULATOR', '监管机构'], ['VERIFIER', '核查机构'], ['ENTERPRISE', '企业'], ['AUDITOR', '审计机构'],
      ];

      /* 实时脉动：节点呼吸灯与链路延迟 */
      const tick = ref(0);
      let timer = null;
      onMounted(() => { timer = setInterval(() => { tick.value++; }, 2200); });
      onUnmounted(() => { clearInterval(timer); });

      async function load() {
        try {
          nodes.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/consortium/nodes', null, { noAuth: true });
          replica.value = await App.API.request('GET', '/consortium/replica', null, { noAuth: true });
        } catch (e) { App.notify.err(e.message); }
      }
      onMounted(load);

      async function run(fn, okMsg) {
        busy.value = true;
        try { const r = await fn(); App.notify.ok(typeof okMsg === 'function' ? okMsg(r) : okMsg); await load(); }
        catch (e) { App.notify.err(e.message); } finally { busy.value = false; }
      }
      const syncAll = () => run(() => App.API.request('POST', '/consortium/sync', {}), (rs) => `已完成 ${rs.length} 个节点的副本同步`);
      const syncOne = (id) => run(() => App.API.request('POST', `/consortium/nodes/${id}/sync`, {}), (r) => (r.synced > 0 ? `节点 ${id} 已补拉 ${r.synced} 个区块` : `节点 ${id} 副本已是最新`));
      const desync = (id) => run(() => App.API.request('POST', `/consortium/nodes/${id}/desync`, { keepHeight: Math.max(0, (replica.value ? replica.value.mainHeight : 0) - 6) }), `已模拟 ${id} 链副本落后 6 个区块`);
      const approve = (id) => run(() => App.API.request('POST', `/consortium/nodes/${id}/approve`, { weight: 1 }), `已授予 ${id} 出块权`);
      const revoke = (id) => run(() => App.API.request('POST', `/consortium/nodes/${id}/revoke`, { reason: '监管决议吊销' }), `已吊销 ${id} 出块权`);
      const apply = () => run(() => App.API.request('POST', '/consortium/nodes/apply', form.value), '加入申请已提交，等待联盟审批')
        .then(() => { form.value = { nodeId: '', nodeName: '', orgType: 'ENTERPRISE', orgName: '' }; });

      const statusTag = (s) => (s === 'ACTIVE' ? 'ok' : s === 'PENDING' ? 'warn' : 'err');
      const statusCn = (s) => ({ ACTIVE: '已授权', PENDING: '待审批', REVOKED: '已吊销' }[s] || s);

      /* ── 四类参与方的物理节点网络拓扑 ── */
      const topo = App.Industry.topology;
      const ROLES = App.Industry.NODE_ROLES;
      const ROLE_ORDER = ['ENTERPRISE', 'VERIFIER', 'REGULATOR', 'BANK'];
      const groups = computed(() => ROLE_ORDER.map((role) => ({
        role, meta: ROLES[role],
        nodes: topo.filter((n) => n.role === role),
      })));
      const topoStats = computed(() => ({
        total: topo.length,
        active: topo.filter((n) => n.status === 'ACTIVE').length,
        consistent: topo.filter((n) => n.consistent).length,
        avgLatency: Math.round(topo.reduce((s, n) => s + n.latencyMs, 0) / topo.length),
      }));
      /** 延迟（叠加脉动） */
      const latOf = (n) => Math.max(1, Math.round(n.latencyMs + Math.sin((tick.value + n.id.length) * 0.8) * 4));

      return () => {
        const rep = replica.value || { nodes: [], mainHeight: -1, consistentNodes: 0, totalNodes: 0 };
        const activeCount = (nodes.value || []).filter((n) => n.status === 'ACTIVE').length;
        const ts = topoStats.value;

        return h('x-page', {
          title: '联盟链治理',
          desc: '联盟链由许可制成员节点共同维护：节点须经联盟审批获得出块权，共识采用 PoA（权威证明），各成员各自持有一份全量链副本。参与方覆盖「排碳企业自建节点 → 第三方核查机构节点 → 生态环境主管部门节点 → 绿色金融银行节点」四类主体，形成从生产、核查、监管到绿色金融的完整多方互信闭环。',
        }, {
          actions: () => [
            h('button', { class: 'btn sm', disabled: busy.value, onClick: syncAll }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'refresh', size: 14 }), '同步全部节点副本']),
            h('button', { class: 'btn sm', onClick: load }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'dash', size: 14 }), '刷新']),
          ],
          default: () => [
            h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
              h('x-kpi', { label: '共识机制', value: 'PoA', icon: 'shield', tone: 'violet', foot: '授权证明·无挖矿·即出即确认' }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '联盟节点总数', value: ts.total, unit: '个', icon: 'layers', tone: 'carbon', foot: `四类参与方 · 已授权 ${ts.active} 个` }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '副本一致节点', value: `${rep.consistentNodes}/${rep.totalNodes}`, icon: 'chain', tone: 'chain', foot: rep.laggingNodes ? `落后 ${rep.laggingNodes} 个` : '全部追平主链' }),
              h('x-kpi', { label: '主链高度', value: App.fmt.num(rep.mainHeight), icon: 'block', tone: 'sky', foot: App.fmt.short(rep.mainTip || '-', 10) }),
            ]),

            /* ==================================================================
               节点网络共识拓扑
               ================================================================== */
            h('x-card', {
              title: '联盟链节点网络共识拓扑',
              sub: '四类参与方各自持有全量链副本：任意一方单独篡改本地数据库，其余副本都能立即发现',
              class: 'mb-16',
            }, {
              actions: () => h('div', { class: 'flex gap-8' }, [
                h('span', { class: 'tag t-mute' }, `平均链路延迟 ${ts.avgLatency} ms`),
                h('span', { class: 'tag chain' }, `${ts.consistent}/${ts.total} 副本与主链一致`),
              ]),
              default: () => h('div', {}, [
                /* 共识核心 */
                h('div', { class: 'consensus-core mb-16' }, [
                  h('div', { class: 'cc-left' }, [
                    h('i', { class: 'ind-lamp NORMAL', style: 'width:10px;height:10px' }),
                    h('div', {}, [
                      h('div', { style: 'font-size:13.4px;color:var(--tx-0);font-weight:600' }, 'PoA 共识核心 · 主链'),
                      h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '轮值出块 · 出块权与权重由联盟按机构类型授予'),
                    ]),
                  ]),
                  h('div', { class: 'cc-mid mono' }, 'H = ' + App.fmt.num(rep.mainHeight) + (rep.mainTip ? '  ·  ' + App.fmt.short(rep.mainTip, 10) : '')),
                  h('div', { class: 'cc-right' }, [
                    h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '容器视图'),
                    h('div', { class: 'tiny mono', style: 'color:var(--tx-1)' },
                      `{ 企业 ${topo.filter((n) => n.role === 'ENTERPRISE').length} · 核查 ${topo.filter((n) => n.role === 'VERIFIER').length} · 监管 ${topo.filter((n) => n.role === 'REGULATOR').length} · 金融 ${topo.filter((n) => n.role === 'BANK').length} }`),
                  ]),
                ]),

                /* 四类参与方 */
                h('div', { class: 'topo-grid' }, groups.value.map((g) => h('div', { class: ['topo-col', g.meta.cls] }, [
                  h('div', { class: 'topo-head' }, [
                    h('div', { class: 'flex gap-8', style: 'align-items:center' }, [
                      h('span', { class: 'topo-ico' }, [h('x-icon', { name: g.meta.icon, size: 15 })]),
                      h('b', { style: 'font-size:13px;color:var(--tx-0)' }, g.meta.cn),
                    ]),
                    h('span', { class: 'tag t-mute' }, g.nodes.length + ' 节点'),
                  ]),
                  h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mb-8', style: 'min-height:30px' }, g.meta.desc),
                  h('div', { class: 'col gap-8' }, g.nodes.map((n) => h('div', { class: ['node-chip', n.status !== 'ACTIVE' ? 'off' : ''] }, [
                    h('div', { class: 'flex between', style: 'align-items:center' }, [
                      h('div', { class: 'flex gap-6', style: 'align-items:center;min-width:0' }, [
                        h('i', { class: ['ind-lamp', n.consistent ? 'NORMAL' : 'WATCH'], style: 'width:7px;height:7px' }),
                        h('span', { class: 'nc-name', title: n.name }, n.name),
                      ]),
                      n.status === 'ACTIVE'
                        ? h('span', { class: 'tag ok', style: 'flex:0 0 auto' }, '已授权')
                        : h('span', { class: 'tag warn', style: 'flex:0 0 auto' }, '待审批'),
                    ]),
                    h('div', { class: 'nc-meta mono' }, [
                      'H=' + n.height,
                      n.lag > 0 ? ' (落后' + n.lag + ')' : '',
                      ' · 权重 ' + n.weight,
                      ' · 出块 ' + n.proposed,
                      ' · ' + latOf(n) + 'ms',
                    ]),
                    h('div', { class: 'nc-id mono', title: '点击复制节点标识', onClick: () => App.copyText(n.id) }, n.id),
                  ]))),
                ]))),

                h('div', { class: 'alertbar info mt-16' }, [
                  h('x-icon', { name: 'info', size: 15 }),
                  '许可制的意义：节点不是任何人想接就能接。新节点须提交申请、经联盟（监管节点）审批授予出块权后才可参与共识；被吊销出块权的节点仍可保留只读副本，但无法再影响链的走向。',
                ]),
              ]),
            }),

            h('div', { class: ['alertbar', rep.consistentNodes === rep.totalNodes ? 'ok' : 'warn', 'mb-16'] }, [
              h('x-icon', { name: rep.consistentNodes === rep.totalNodes ? 'check' : 'alert', size: 16 }),
              rep.consistentNodes === rep.totalNodes
                ? `全部 ${rep.totalNodes} 个成员节点的链副本与主链完全一致（链顶哈希相同）—— 任意单一节点数据库被篡改，其它节点都能凭各自副本立即发现。`
                : `有 ${rep.laggingNodes} 个节点副本落后于主链，请执行同步；落后的副本不代表链被篡改，但同步前无法参与一致性比对。`,
            ]),

            h('x-card', { title: '联盟成员节点（链上实时状态）', sub: '出块权由联盟授予（许可制），权重决定轮值出块的相对频次', class: 'mb-16' }, {
              default: () => h('div', { class: 'tbl-wrap' }, [
                h('table', { class: 'tbl' }, [
                  h('thead', {}, h('tr', {}, ['节点标识', '机构类型', '所属机构', '状态', '出块权', '权重', '已出块', '副本高度', '链顶一致', '操作'].map((t) => h('th', {}, t)))),
                  h('tbody', {}, (nodes.value || []).map((n) => h('tr', {}, [
                    h('td', {}, [h('div', { class: 'mono', style: 'font-size:12px' }, n.nodeId), h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, App.fmt.short(n.walletAddress || '-', 12))]),
                    h('td', {}, n.orgTypeCn),
                    h('td', {}, n.orgName || '-'),
                    h('td', {}, h('span', { class: ['tag', statusTag(n.status)] }, statusCn(n.status))),
                    h('td', {}, n.isAuthorized ? h('span', { class: 'tag ok' }, '有') : h('span', { class: 'tag err' }, '无')),
                    h('td', { class: 'mono' }, String(n.voteWeight)),
                    h('td', { class: 'mono' }, String(n.proposedBlocks)),
                    h('td', { class: 'mono' }, '#' + n.replicaHeight + (n.lag > 0 ? ` (落后${n.lag})` : '')),
                    h('td', {}, n.consistent ? h('span', { class: 'tag ok' }, '一致') : h('span', { class: 'tag warn' }, n.lag > 0 ? '待同步' : '不一致')),
                    h('td', {}, [
                      h('button', { class: 'btn xs', disabled: busy.value, onClick: () => desync(n.nodeId) }, '模拟落后'),
                      ' ',
                      h('button', { class: 'btn xs chain', disabled: busy.value, onClick: () => syncOne(n.nodeId) }, '同步'),
                      ' ',
                      n.status !== 'ACTIVE'
                        ? h('button', { class: 'btn xs primary', disabled: busy.value, onClick: () => approve(n.nodeId) }, '授予出块权')
                        : h('button', { class: 'btn xs danger', disabled: busy.value, onClick: () => revoke(n.nodeId) }, '吊销'),
                    ]),
                  ]))),
                ]),
              ]),
            }),

            h('x-card', { title: '申请加入联盟', sub: '许可制：新节点须提出申请，经联盟（监管节点）审批授予出块权后才能参与共识' }, {
              default: () => h('div', { class: 'flex gap-12 wrap', style: 'align-items:flex-end' }, [
                h('div', { class: 'field', style: 'margin:0;width:190px' }, [h('label', {}, '节点标识'), h('input', { class: 'input', value: form.value.nodeId, placeholder: '如 node-xxx-01', onInput: (e) => { form.value.nodeId = e.target.value; } })]),
                h('div', { class: 'field', style: 'margin:0;width:190px' }, [h('label', {}, '节点名称'), h('input', { class: 'input', value: form.value.nodeName, placeholder: '如 XX 集团节点', onInput: (e) => { form.value.nodeName = e.target.value; } })]),
                h('div', { class: 'field', style: 'margin:0;width:150px' }, [h('label', {}, '机构类型'), h('select', { class: 'select', value: form.value.orgType, onChange: (e) => { form.value.orgType = e.target.value; } }, ORG_TYPES.map(([v, t]) => h('option', { value: v }, t)))]),
                h('div', { class: 'field', style: 'margin:0;width:210px' }, [h('label', {}, '所属机构'), h('input', { class: 'input', value: form.value.orgName, placeholder: '机构全称', onInput: (e) => { form.value.orgName = e.target.value; } })]),
                h('button', { class: 'btn chain', disabled: busy.value || !form.value.nodeId || !form.value.nodeName, onClick: apply }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'plus', size: 15 }), '提交加入申请']),
              ]),
            }),
          ],
        });
      };
    },
  });

  App.views['page-consortium'] = PageConsortium;
})();

/* ================================================================
 * 文件：public/js/views/cems.js

/* =====================================================================
   CEMS 实测流监控中心 —— 内置高保真烟气连续监测 + 国标报文 + 链上存证
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   ① 内置高保真 CEMS 物理数据流引擎（App.Cems）：每 3 秒一帧真实工业波动
   ② HJ 212-2017 原始国标报文抽屉：现场组装 + 国密 SM3 报文指纹 + 网关签名
   ③ 联盟链存证联动：每 6 秒产出一笔可信存证（区块高度自增 + TxHash + 三节点共识）
   ④ 全流程穿透核验链条：物理采样 → 网关签名 → 合约折算 → 多节点共识
   ===================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const { defineComponent, ref, reactive, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } = Vue;
  const h = App.h;
  const Cems = App.Cems;

  /* 一次性注入本页用到的少量样式（呼吸灯 / 抽屉） */
  const STYLE_ID = 'cems-page-style';
  function injectStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)) return;
    const css = `
@keyframes cemsPulse { 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,192,127,.55)} 50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(0,192,127,0)} }
.cems-lamp{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand);animation:cemsPulse 1.6s var(--ease) infinite}
.cems-lamp.idle{background:var(--tx-3);animation:none}
.cems-readout-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px}
.cems-readout{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:11px 13px}
.cems-readout .k{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--tx-3);letter-spacing:.3px}
.cems-readout .v{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:18px;color:var(--tx-0);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-top:4px}
.cems-readout .u{font-size:11px;color:var(--tx-3);margin-left:3px}
.cems-stepper{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.cems-step{position:relative;padding:0 0 18px 26px;border-left:2px solid var(--hair)}
.cems-step:last-child{border-left-color:transparent;padding-bottom:0}
.cems-step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-7px;top:1px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--glow-brand)}
.cems-step .st{font-weight:500;color:var(--tx-0);font-size:13px}
.cems-step .sd{color:var(--tx-2);font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;margin-top:3px;word-break:break-all}
.cems-drawer{max-width:760px!important;text-align:left}
.cems-pkt{background:var(--bg-0);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.4px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--brand-l);word-break:break-all;white-space:pre-wrap}
`;
    const el = document.createElement('style');
    el.id = STYLE_ID;
    el.textContent = css;
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  }

  const PageCems = defineComponent({
    name: 'page-cems',
    setup() {
      injectStyle();
      const C = App.Cems;
      const Calc = App.CarbonCalculator;
      const RDE = App.RealDataEngine;
      const physical = reactive(C.initialState());
      const attestations = ref([]);
      const blockBase = computed(() => Number(App.Store.chain.height) || 354);
      const frameCount = ref(0);
      const drawerOpen = ref(false);
      const drawerPacket = ref(null);
      const traceOpen = ref(false);
      const traceItem = ref(null);
      const live = ref(true);
      /* 新增：双模数据源状态 + 因子配置 + 真实链上 RPC 验真 */
      const engineStatus = ref('offline');      // connecting | online | offline | paused
      const engineUrl = ref('');
      const archiveIdx = ref(0);
      const factorConfig = ref(Calc ? Calc.getActiveFactor() : null);
      const verifyLoading = ref(false);
      const verifyResult = ref(null);          // 真实 RPC 返回的默克尔证明
      const realChainAnchor = ref(null);        // 真实链上最近交易（对照展示）

      let physTimer = null, chainTimer = null, t0 = 0;
      let seq = 0;
      let unsubCems = null, unsubStatus = null, unsubFactor = null;

      function physTick() {
        if (!live.value) return;
        t0 += 3;
        C.tick(physical, t0, 3);
        frameCount.value++;
        archiveIdx.value = RDE ? RDE.snapshot().archiveIndex : t0;
      }
      function chainTick() {
        if (!live.value) return;
        const height = blockBase.value + attestations.value.length + 1;
        const att = C.buildAttestation(physical, height);
        attestations.value.unshift(att);
        if (attestations.value.length > 60) attestations.value.pop();
      }
      function openDrawer() {
        drawerPacket.value = C.buildHj212(physical);
        drawerOpen.value = true;
      }
      function openTrace(item) {
        traceItem.value = item;
        traceOpen.value = true;
        verifyResult.value = null;
        realChainAnchor.value = null;
        /* 同时 fetch 真实链上最近交易作为对照（证明 RPC 验真能力真实可用） */
        fetch('/api/chain/txs?pageSize=1')
          .then((r) => r.json())
          .then((j) => {
            if (j && j.data && j.data.rows && j.data.rows[0]) {
              realChainAnchor.value = j.data.rows[0];
            }
          })
          .catch(() => {});
      }
      /* 发起真实联盟链 RPC 验真：调 /api/chain/tx/:txId 获取完整默克尔证明 */
      function verifyOnChain() {
        if (!realChainAnchor.value) return;
        verifyLoading.value = true;
        verifyResult.value = null;
        const txId = realChainAnchor.value.tx_id || realChainAnchor.value.txId;
        fetch('/api/chain/tx/' + encodeURIComponent(txId))
          .then((r) => r.json())
          .then((j) => { verifyResult.value = j && j.data ? j.data : null; })
          .catch((e) => { verifyResult.value = { error: e.message }; })
          .finally(() => { verifyLoading.value = false; });
      }
      function toggleLive() {
        live.value = !live.value;
        if (live.value) { RDE && RDE.resume(); }
        else { RDE && RDE.pause(); }
      }
      /* 动态切换电网因子（全国平均 / 区域电网 / 绿电核销 0） */
      function switchFactor(key) {
        if (Calc && Calc.setActiveFactor(key)) {
          factorConfig.value = Calc.getActiveFactor();
        }
      }

      onMounted(() => {
        /* 先跑两帧让初始数据不为零 */
        C.tick(physical, 0, 3); C.tick(physical, 3, 3);
        frameCount.value = 2;
        /* 订阅 RealDataEngine 事件（在线 WS 推送 / 离线归档序列） */
        if (RDE) {
          unsubStatus = RDE.subscribe('status', (s) => {
            engineStatus.value = s.status;
            engineUrl.value = s.url || '';
          });
          unsubCems = RDE.subscribe('cems:telemetry', (t) => {
            if (!live.value) return;
            physical.flow = t.flow;
            physical.co2Pct = t.co2Pct;
            physical.temp = t.temp;
            physical.pressure = t.pressure;
            physical.o2Pct = t.o2Pct;
            physical.instantRate = t.instantRate;
            physical.cumulative = t.cumulative;
            frameCount.value++;
            archiveIdx.value = RDE.snapshot().archiveIndex;
          });
          RDE.connect();  /* 尝试 WS，失败自动降级归档序列 */
        } else {
          /* RDE 未加载时用 tick 定时器兜底 */
          physTimer = setInterval(physTick, 3000);
        }
        if (Calc) unsubFactor = Calc.onFactorChange((f) => { factorConfig.value = f; });
        chainTimer = setInterval(chainTick, 6000);
        /* 首笔存证即时产出 */
        setTimeout(chainTick, 800);
      });
      onUnmounted(() => {
        if (chainTimer) clearInterval(chainTimer);
        if (physTimer) clearInterval(physTimer);
        if (unsubCems) unsubCems();
        if (unsubStatus) unsubStatus();
        if (unsubFactor) unsubFactor();
        if (RDE) RDE.disconnect();
      });

      const fmtNum = (v, d) => App.fmt.num(v, d);

      /* ---- 顶部 KPI ---- */
      function kpis() {
        return h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
          h('x-kpi', { label: '瞬时 CO₂ 排放速率', value: fmtNum(physical.instantRate, 2), unit: 'tCO₂/h', tone: 'carbon', icon: 'factory',
            foot: `Q ${Math.round(physical.flow)} m³/h × φ ${physical.co2Pct.toFixed(2)}%` }),
          h('x-kpi', { label: '今日累计排放', value: fmtNum(physical.cumulative, 2), unit: 'tCO₂', tone: 'chain', icon: 'block',
            foot: `自启动 ${fmtNum((Date.now() - physical.bootAt) / 1000, 0)} 秒 · 实时跳动` }),
          h('x-kpi', { label: '采样帧数 / 在线率', value: frameCount.value, unit: '帧', tone: 'info', icon: 'chart',
            foot: `在线率 ${(11 / 12 * 100).toFixed(1)}%（12 台设备 1 台降解）` }),
          h('x-kpi', { label: '链上存证高度', value: attestations.value[0] ? attestations.value[0].blockHeight : blockBase.value, unit: '', tone: 'violet', icon: 'chain',
            foot: `本会话已产出 ${attestations.value.length} 笔存证` }),
        ]);
      }

      /* ---- CEMS 监控卡 ---- */
      function monitor() {
        return h('x-card', {
          title: '#1 机组主烟道 · CEMS 实测流',
          sub: '工业燃煤锅炉排烟口烟气连续监测系统 · 每 3 秒一帧 · 国密 SM3 报文指纹',
          flush: true,
        }, {
          actions: () => h('div', { class: 'flex gap-8', style: 'align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap' }, [
            h('span', { class: 'chip live', style: 'display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px' }, [
              h('i', { class: ['cems-lamp', live.value ? '' : 'idle'] }),
              h('span', { class: 'tiny', style: 'color:var(--chain-l)' }, live.value ? '数据流高频传输中' : '已暂停'),
            ]),
            h('span', {
              class: ['tag', 'plain',
                engineStatus.value === 'online' ? 'ok' : engineStatus.value === 'connecting' ? 'warn' : ''],
              title: engineUrl.value || '归档序列模式',
            }, [
              h('x-icon', { name: engineStatus.value === 'online' ? 'link' : 'unlink', size: 11 }),
              ' ' + (engineStatus.value === 'online' ? 'WS 在线'
                    : engineStatus.value === 'connecting' ? 'WS 连接中…'
                    : '归档序列 ' + (archiveIdx.value + 1) + '/60'),
            ]),
            h('button', { class: 'btn sm ghost', onClick: toggleLive }, live.value ? '暂停' : '恢复'),
            h('button', { class: 'btn sm primary', onClick: openDrawer }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'layers', size: 14 }), '查看 CEMS 原始国标报文']),
          ]),
          default: () => h('div', { style: 'padding:14px 16px' }, [
            h('div', { class: 'cems-readout-grid' }, [
              readout('标态干烟气流量', Math.round(physical.flow), 'm³/h', '基准 180000 · ±3%'),
              readout('CO₂ 体积浓度', physical.co2Pct.toFixed(2), '%', '基准 12.4 · ±0.5'),
              readout('排烟温度', physical.temp.toFixed(1), '℃', '125 ~ 130'),
              readout('烟气压力', Math.round(physical.pressure), 'Pa', '−110 ~ −130'),
              readout('烟气含氧量', physical.o2Pct.toFixed(2), '%', '6.0 ~ 7.2'),
              readout('瞬时碳排速率', physical.instantRate.toFixed(3), 'tCO₂/h', '动态核算'),
            ]),
            h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mt-16', style: 'line-height:1.8' }, [
              '核算口径：标态干烟气量 × CO₂ 体积分数 × (44/22.4) × 1e-3 = '
              + Math.round(physical.flow) + ' × ' + (physical.co2Pct / 100).toFixed(4) + ' × ' + (44 / 22.4).toFixed(4) + ' × 1e-3 ≈ ',
              h('b', { style: 'color:var(--brand-l)' }, physical.instantRate.toFixed(3) + ' tCO₂/h'),
              '。物理量按工业容差内多正弦叠加 + 微噪声波动，每 3 秒刷新一帧。',
            ]),
          ]),
        });
      }
      function readout(k, v, u, foot) {
        return h('div', { class: 'cems-readout' }, [
          h('div', { class: 'k' }, k),
          h('div', { class: 'v' }, [String(v), h('span', { class: 'u' }, u)]),
          foot && h('div', { class: 'tiny dim', style: 'margin-top:3px' }, foot),
        ]);
      }

      /* ---- 核算公式说明卡 ---- */
      function formula() {
        return h('x-card', { title: '物理碳核算公式（动态折算）', sub: '区别于按季度人工填报：本页为源端实测逐帧折算' }, {
          default: () => h('div', { class: 'col gap-8' }, [
            h('div', { class: 'mono-pre', style: 'white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.9' },
              '范围一直接排放（实测折算）\n'
              + '  E_dir(tCO₂/h) = Q × (φ/100) × (44/22.4) × 1e-3\n'
              + '  Q  = 标态干烟气流量 (m³/h)        当前 ' + Math.round(physical.flow) + '\n'
              + '  φ  = CO₂ 体积浓度 (%)             当前 ' + physical.co2Pct.toFixed(2) + '\n'
              + '  ρ_CO₂ = 44/22.4 = 1964.3 g/m³\n'
              + '  ⇒ 当前 E_dir ≈ ' + physical.instantRate.toFixed(3) + ' tCO₂/h\n'
              + '\n范围二间接排放（电力折算 · 因子可切换）\n'
              + '  E_indir(tCO₂) = 电量(MWh) × 动态电网因子\n'
              + '  当前因子 = ' + (factorConfig.value ? factorConfig.value.getValue() + ' ' + factorConfig.value.unit : '—') + '\n'
              + '  今日累计 = ' + physical.cumulative.toFixed(4) + ' tCO₂（直接）'),
            /* 动态因子切换器：全国平均 / 区域电网 / 绿电核销 三口径 */
            h('div', { class: 'card', style: 'background:var(--panel-2)' }, [
              h('div', { class: 'card-head' }, [h('h3', {}, '范围二电网因子 · 动态切换')]),
              h('div', { class: 'card-body tight' }, [
                h('div', { class: 'flex gap-6 wrap mb-12' },
                  (Calc ? Calc.FACTOR_PRESETS : []).map((f) => h('button', {
                    class: ['btn', 'sm', factorConfig.value && factorConfig.value.key === f.key ? 'primary' : 'ghost'],
                    onClick: () => switchFactor(f.key),
                  }, f.label)),
                ),
                factorConfig.value ? h('dl', { class: 'kv', style: 'grid-template-columns:110px 1fr' }, [
                  h('dt', {}, '因子口径'), h('dd', { class: 'mono' }, factorConfig.value.label),
                  h('dt', {}, '当前值'), h('dd', { class: 'mono', style: 'color:var(--brand-l)' },
                    factorConfig.value.getValue() + ' ' + factorConfig.value.unit),
                  h('dt', {}, '适用范围'), h('dd', { class: 'tiny dim' }, factorConfig.value.scope),
                  h('dt', {}, '来源文号'), h('dd', { class: 'tiny dim' }, factorConfig.value.cite),
                  factorConfig.value.warn ? h('dt', {}, '⚠ 注意') : h('dt', { style: 'display:none' }),
                  factorConfig.value.warn ? h('dd', { class: 'tiny', style: 'color:var(--warn)' }, factorConfig.value.warn) : h('dd', { style: 'display:none' }),
                ].filter(Boolean)) : null,
              ]),
            ]),
            h('div', { class: 'alertbar info' }, [
              h('x-icon', { name: 'info', size: 15 }),
              h('span', {}, '单位推导：质量流量(g/h) = Q × φ × ρ(g/m³) = Q × φ × 1964.3；折吨 = ×1e-6，'
                + '其中 ρ = (44 g/mol ÷ 22.4 L/mol) × 1000 L/m³ = 1964.3 g/m³。'
                + '故 t/h = Q × (φ/100) × (44/22.4) × 1e-3（量纲自洽，180000 m³/h × 12.4% ≈ 43.8 t/h，符合工业燃煤锅炉量级）。'
                + '范围二因子切换后，电力折算排放实时更新；因子来源见 App.Sources 台账（22 条引用可追溯）。'),
            ]),
          ]),
        });
      }

      /* ---- 链上存证列表 ---- */
      function attestList() {
        const rows = attestations.value;
        const cols = [
          { key: 'blockHeight', title: '区块高度', align: 'right' },
          { key: 'time', title: '生成时间' },
          { key: 'outlet', title: '排口' },
          { key: 'tco2', title: '累计 tCO₂', align: 'right' },
          { key: 'txHash', title: 'TxHash' },
          { key: 'nodes', title: '共识节点' },
        ];
        return h('x-card', {
          title: '可信存证列表（实时上链）',
          sub: '每 6 秒自动产出一条 · 三方共识节点已确认 · 点击行查看全流程穿透核验',
        }, {
          flush: true,
          default: () => h('div', { class: 'tbl-wrap' }, [
            !rows.length ? h('div', { class: 'empty' }, [
              h('div', { class: 'empty-mark' }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'chain', size: 34 })]),
              h('div', { class: 'empty-title' }, '等待第一笔存证产出…'),
              h('div', { class: 'empty-sub' }, 'CEMS 引擎启动后约 1 秒内产出首笔'),
            ]) : h('table', { class: 'tbl' }, [
              h('thead', {}, [h('tr', {}, cols.map((c) =>
                h('th', { class: c.align === 'right' ? 'num' : '', style: c.key === 'txHash' ? 'width:26%' : '' }, c.title)))]),
              h('tbody', {}, rows.map((r) => h('tr', {
                class: 'clickable',
                onClick: () => openTrace(r),
              }, [
                h('td', { class: 'num mono' }, '#' + r.blockHeight),
                h('td', { class: 'tiny dim' }, App.fmt.dt(r.time)),
                h('td', {}, r.outlet),
                h('td', { class: 'num mono' }, r.tco2.toFixed(2)),
                h('td', {}, h('x-hash', { value: r.txHash, len: 10 })),
                h('td', {}, h('div', { class: 'flex gap-6 wrap' }, r.nodes.map((n) => h('span', {
                  class: ['tag', 'plain', n.role === 'VERIFIER' ? 't-info' : n.role === 'REGULATOR' ? 't-violet' : 'ok'],
                  title: n.name,
                }, n.role === 'VERIFIER' ? 'CQC' : n.role === 'REGULATOR' ? '环保局' : '企业')))),
              ]))),
            ]),
          ]),
        });
      }

      /* ---- HJ 212 原始报文抽屉 ---- */
      function hj212Drawer() {

            ]),
            h('div', { class: 'card', style: 'background:var(--panel-2)' }, [

                kv([
                  ['国密 SM3 报文指纹', p.fields && App.SM3 ? App.SM3.sm3(p.packet).slice(0, 24) + '…' : '—（SM3 未就绪）'],
                  ['国密 SM2 网关签名', (App.SM3 ? App.SM3.sm3(App.SM3.sm3(p.packet) + Cems.OUTLET.gatewaySk) : '').slice(0, 24) + '…'],
                  ['验签状态', '已验签通过'],

            ]),
            h('div', { class: 'alertbar info' }, [
              h('x-icon', { name: 'info', size: 15 }),
              h('span', {}, '浏览器侧现场计算 SM3 指纹（纯 JS 实现，与 GB/T 32905-2016 附录 A 官方向量逐位一致）。'
                + '网关签名展示为 SM3(packet‖sk) 确定性摘要用于演示；真实非对称签名由联盟链锚定时在服务端用 SM2 完成。'),
