      /* ---- 判据证伪 ---- */
      function renderFalsify() {
        const f = falsify.value;
        return h('div', { class: 'col gap-16' }, [
          h('x-card', { title: '为什么必须做负向注入', sub: '如果一条判据在任何输入下都通过，它就不是判据' }, {
            default: () => h('div', { class: 'col gap-8' }, [
              h('div', { class: 'tiny', style: 'line-height:1.9' }, App.fmt.md(
                '本项目在开发过程中真实踩到过这个坑：**链上四道校验对"只改链下 payload 正文"完全无感** —— '
                + '因为交易签名签的是 payloadHash、Merkle 叶由 payloadHash 派生后作为独立字段存储，'
                + '所以改链下明文不会惊动任何链上锚点。补上第五道「链下重算绑定」校验后才检出。')),
              h('div', { class: 'tiny dim', style: 'line-height:1.9' }, App.fmt.md(
                '因此本节**故意破坏数据链路**，要求校验逻辑必须报警。报警 = 判据非空。')),
            ]),
          }),
          h('x-card', { title: '四类负向注入实测', sub: '每一类注入都对应一种真实攻击或数据错误' }, {
            flush: true,
            default: () => h('div', { class: 'tbl-wrap' }, [h('table', { class: 'tbl' }, [
              h('thead', {}, [h('tr', {}, [h('th', { style: 'width:40px' }, '#'), h('th', {}, '注入内容'), h('th', { style: 'width:22%' }, '注入方式'), h('th', { style: 'width:20%' }, '期望判据'), h('th', { style: 'width:28%' }, '实测观测'), h('th', { style: 'width:88px' }, '检出')])]),
              h('tbody', {}, f.cases.map((c) => h('tr', {}, [
                h('td', { class: 'mono' }, c.id),
                h('td', {}, c.name),
                h('td', { class: 'mono tiny' }, c.inject),
                h('td', { class: 'tiny dim' }, c.expect),
                h('td', { class: 'mono tiny' }, c.observed),
                h('td', {}, h('span', { class: ['tag', c.detected ? 'ok' : 'err'] }, c.detected ? '已检出' : '漏检')),
              ]))),
            ])]),
          }),
          h('x-card', { title: '判据有效性结论', sub: '实测可复核' }, {
            default: () => h('div', {}, [
              h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
                kpi({ label: '注入用例', value: f.total, unit: '类', tone: 'info', icon: 'alert' }),
                kpi({ label: '成功检出', value: f.detectedCount, unit: '类', tone: 'ok', icon: 'verify' }),
                kpi({ label: '漏检', value: f.total - f.detectedCount, unit: '类', tone: f.total - f.detectedCount === 0 ? 'ok' : 'err', icon: 'shield' }),
                kpi({ label: '批次闭合容差', value: BATCH_TOL, unit: '%', tone: 'violet', icon: 'target', foot: '判据阈值（可调，越小越严）' }),
              ]),
              readout(f.allDetected, '判据非空性验证', f.allDetected
                ? `${f.total} 类故意破坏全部被检出 —— 判据不是"永远通过"的摆设`
                : `存在 ${f.total - f.detectedCount} 类漏检，判据需加强`),
              h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mt-8', style: 'line-height:1.85' }, App.fmt.md(
                '**可复现**：本页的注入用例在浏览器现场执行；同一逻辑也已固化进 '
                + '`scripts/uncertainty.js` 的 `checkFalsification()`，'
                + '评审可 `node scripts/uncertainty.js` 独立重跑并比对。')),
            ]),
          }),
        ]);
      }

      /* ---- 合规映射 ---- */
      function renderCompliance() {
        const std = S.standards || [];
        const pol = S.policies || [];
        const intl = S.internationalRules || [];
        const st = S.stats();
        return h('div', { class: 'col gap-16' }, [
          h('x-card', { title: '合规映射总览', sub: '平台每一项核算主张，都能指到一条标准/政策/规则的哪一款' }, {
            default: () => h('div', {}, [
              h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
                kpi({ label: '可追溯率', value: st.traceabilityPct, unit: '%', tone: 'ok', icon: 'verify', foot: `${st.total} 项因子/参数` }),
                kpi({ label: '官方出处', value: st.citations, unit: '条', tone: 'chain', icon: 'book', foot: `A 级 ${st.byLevel.A} · B 级 ${st.byLevel.B} · C 级 ${st.byLevel.C}` }),
                kpi({ label: '标准', value: st.standards, unit: '部', tone: 'info', icon: 'report', foot: '国标 / 团标 / 国际标准' }),
                kpi({ label: '政策与规则', value: st.policies + st.internationalRules, unit: '部', tone: 'violet', icon: 'shield', foot: `国内 ${st.policies} · 国际 ${st.internationalRules}` }),
              ]),
              h('div', { class: 'tiny dim', style: 'line-height:1.85' }, App.fmt.md(
                '**追溯等级定义**：A = 一手官方发布（附文号/公告号），可直接引用；'
                + 'B = 权威汇编（国标 / 团标 / 交易所披露文件附录）；'
                + 'C = 示例值，仅用于演示，正式申报须替换为官方当期值。')),
            ]),
          }),
          h('x-card', { title: '标准合规映射矩阵', sub: '每一条标准 → 本平台的落地位置' }, {
            flush: true,
            default: () => h('div', { class: 'tbl-wrap' }, [h('table', { class: 'tbl' }, [
              h('thead', {}, [h('tr', {}, [h('th', { style: 'width:150px' }, '标准编号'), h('th', {}, '名称'), h('th', { style: 'width:96px' }, '层级'), h('th', { style: 'width:64px' }, '等级'), h('th', { style: 'width:38%' }, '平台落地')])]),
              h('tbody', {}, std.map((x) => h('tr', {}, [
                h('td', { class: 'mono tiny' }, x.code),
                h('td', {}, [h('div', {}, x.cn), h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, `${x.issuer || ''} ${x.issuedAt || ''}`)]),
                h('td', {}, h('span', { class: 'tag t-info' }, x.level || x.kind)),
                h('td', {}, h('span', { class: ['tag', x.traceLevel === 'A' ? 'ok' : x.traceLevel === 'C' ? 'warn' : 't-info'] }, x.traceLevel + ' 级')),
                h('td', { class: 'tiny', style: 'line-height:1.75' }, App.fmt.md((x.maps ? '对标 ' + x.maps + '；' : '') + (x.note || x.purpose || ''))),
              ]))),
            ])]),
          }),
          h('x-card', { title: '国内政策依据', sub: '制度框架层面的合法性来源' }, {
            flush: true,
            default: () => h('div', { class: 'tbl-wrap' }, [h('table', { class: 'tbl' }, [
              h('thead', {}, [h('tr', {}, [h('th', { style: 'width:26%' }, '政策'), h('th', { style: 'width:16%' }, '发布机关'), h('th', { style: 'width:20%' }, '发布 / 施行'), h('th', { style: 'width:64px' }, '等级'), h('th', {}, '作用')])]),
              h('tbody', {}, pol.map((x) => h('tr', {}, [
                h('td', {}, [h('div', {}, x.cn), x.ref && h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mono' }, x.ref)]),
                h('td', { class: 'tiny' }, x.issuer),
                h('td', { class: 'tiny dim' }, x.issuedAt),
                h('td', {}, h('span', { class: ['tag', x.traceLevel === 'A' ? 'ok' : 't-info'] }, (x.traceLevel || 'B') + ' 级')),
                h('td', { class: 'tiny', style: 'line-height:1.75' }, App.fmt.md(x.purpose || '')),
              ]))),
            ])]),
          }),
          h('x-card', { title: '国际规则与平台映射', sub: '最要紧的一条：欧盟明确排除绿证抵扣电力间接排放' }, {
            default: () => h('div', { class: 'col gap-16' }, intl.map((x) => h('div', {}, [
              h('div', { class: 'flex between mb-16' }, [
                h('div', {}, [
                  h('div', { style: 'font-weight:600;color:var(--tx-0)' }, x.cn),
                  h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mono mt-8' }, x.code + ' · ' + x.ref),
                ]),
                h('span', { class: ['tag', x.traceLevel === 'A' ? 'ok' : 't-info'] }, (x.traceLevel || 'B') + ' 级'),
              ]),
              x.status ? h('div', { class: 'alertbar info mb-16' }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'alert', size: 15 }), h('span', {}, App.fmt.md(x.status))]) : null,
              x.coverage ? h('div', { class: 'flex gap-6 wrap mb-16' }, x.coverage.map((c) => h('span', { class: 'tag t-mute plain' }, c))) : null,
              x.expansion ? h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mb-16', style: 'line-height:1.8' }, App.fmt.md('**扩围**：' + x.expansion)) : null,
              x.mechanics ? h('div', { class: 'tbl-wrap mb-16' }, [h('table', { class: 'tbl' }, [
                h('tbody', {}, Object.keys(x.mechanics).map((k) => h('tr', {}, [
                  h('td', { style: 'width:30%', class: 'tiny dim' }, MECH_CN[k] || k),
                  h('td', { class: 'tiny', style: 'line-height:1.75' }, App.fmt.md(x.mechanics[k])),
                ]))),
              ])]) : null,
              x.impactCN ? h('div', { class: 'mb-16' }, [
                h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mb-16', style: 'line-height:1.8' }, App.fmt.md(
                  '**对中国出口的影响**：按缺省值法核算，每吨 CBAM 钢铁产品可能额外支付 '
                  + x.impactCN.costPerTonSteel.min + ' ~ ' + x.impactCN.costPerTonSteel.max
                  + ' ' + x.impactCN.costPerTonSteel.unit + '。' + x.impactCN.verification)),
                h('div', { class: 'tiny dim', style: 'line-height:1.8' }, App.fmt.md(x.impactCN.defaultPenalty)),
              ]) : null,
              x.platformMapping ? h('div', {}, [
                sub('本平台对应能力'),
                h('div', { class: 'col gap-8' }, x.platformMapping.map((p) => h('div', {
                  class: 'readout pass', style: 'font-size:12.4px',
                }, [h('span', { class: 'flag' }, 'MAP'), h('span', {}, App.fmt.md(p))]))),
              ]) : null,
              x.criticalFact ? h('div', { class: 'alertbar err mt-16' }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'alert', size: 15 }), h('span', {}, App.fmt.md(x.criticalFact))]) : null,
            ]))),
          }),
        ]);
      }

      return () => h('x-page', {
        title: '科研验证中心',
        desc: '全部算法主张摊开成可被质证的证据面板：可复现（固定种子）、可证伪（负向注入）、可复核（现场重算）',
      }, {
        actions: () => [
          h('span', { class: ['tag', allPass.value ? 'ok' : 'err'] }, allPass.value ? '六项验证全部通过' : '存在未通过项'),
          h('button', { class: 'btn sm', onClick: () => { runMC(); }, disabled: busy.value },
            [h('x-icon', { name: 'refresh', size: 14 }), '重跑抽样']),
        ],
        default: () => h('div', {}, [
          tabsBar(),
          tab.value === 'overview' ? renderOverview() : null,
          tab.value === 'reconcile' ? renderReconcile() : null,
          tab.value === 'uncertainty' ? renderUncertainty() : null,
          tab.value === 'bench' ? renderBench() : null,
          tab.value === 'falsify' ? renderFalsify() : null,
          tab.value === 'compliance' ? renderCompliance() : null,
        ]),
      });
    },
  });

  App.views['page-verify'] = PageVerify;
})();

/* ================================================================
 * 文件：public/js/views/matrix.js
 * ================================================================ */
/* =====================================================================
   碳矩阵工业大盘（page-matrix）
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   面向工业场景的联盟链碳资产动态核算可信存证平台主界面。
   参考蚂蚁数科"碳矩阵"产品交互规范，采用三栏协同 + 验真抽屉布局。

   数据流（严禁 Math.random）：
     · realDataEngine 60 组工业归档序列驱动瞬时排碳/烟气流量/用电负荷
     · App.Sources.powerFactors.national（0.5703）作动态碳折算因子
     · App.Cems.buildHj212/buildAttestation/fingerprint/gatewaySign 现场计算
     · /api/chain/blocks 拉取真实链上最近 5 笔存证
     · App.showChainProof 复用全局验真抽屉（四级防篡改证据链）
   ===================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const { defineComponent, ref, reactive, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } = Vue;
  const h = App.h;

  /* ---- 点位台账（电弧炉/高炉/燃煤机组三类工业场景） ---- */
  const POINTS = [
    { code: 'HG-EAF-01', name: '杭钢特钢 01 号电弧炉机组', did: 'did:cch:hg-eaf-01-gw', process: '电弧炉炼钢', bom: ['废钢入料', '高温熔炼', '精炼连铸'] },
    { code: 'BW-BF-02', name: '宝武湛江 2 号高炉', did: 'did:cch:bw-bf-02-gw', process: '高炉炼铁', bom: ['矿石入炉', '高炉冶炼', '铁水预处理'] },
    { code: 'HN-COAL-04', name: '华能玉环 4 号机组', did: 'did:cch:hn-coal-04-gw', process: '燃煤发电', bom: ['煤粉制备', '锅炉燃烧', '烟气脱硫'] },
  ];

  /* ---- 工序能耗/碳排分摊系数（基于电弧炉炼钢典型工况，公开文献） ---- */
  const BOM_SPLIT = [
    { stage: '废钢入料', energyPct: 0.08, carbonPct: 0.05, desc: '废钢预处理 + 装料' },
    { stage: '高温熔炼', energyPct: 0.72, carbonPct: 0.78, desc: '电弧炉主熔炼期' },
    { stage: '精炼连铸', energyPct: 0.20, carbonPct: 0.17, desc: 'LF 精炼 + 连铸坯' },
  ];

  const PageMatrix = defineComponent({
    name: 'page-matrix',
    setup() {
      const RDE = App.RealDataEngine;
      const CEMS = App.Cems;
      const SOURCES = App.Sources;

      /* ---- 状态 ---- */
      const pointIdx = ref(0);
      const point = computed(() => POINTS[pointIdx.value]);
      const cemsState = ref(CEMS.initialState());
      const energyFrame = ref(RDE.ARCHIVE_ENERGY_60[0]);
      const frameIdx = ref(0);
      const chainBlocks = ref([]);
      const chainStats = ref({ height: 0, totalTxs: 0, difficulty: 0, nodes: 4 });
      const hjModal = reactive({ show: false, packet: '', crc: '', sm3: '', sig: '', body: '', fields: null });
      const probeModal = reactive({ show: false, loading: false, txId: '', data: null, error: '' });
      const curveWindow = ref([]);  // 双轴曲线滚动窗口（最近 30 帧）
      const cumulativeToday = ref(0);  // 今日累计存证 tCO₂

      let frameTimer = null, blockTimer = null;

      /* ---- 推进一帧：归档序列驱动 ---- */
      function advanceFrame() {
        const idx = frameIdx.value;
        const frame = RDE.archiveFrame(idx);
        const energy = RDE.ARCHIVE_ENERGY_60[idx % RDE.ARCHIVE_ENERGY_60.length];
        // 推进 cems state（用 tick 复用物理状态机）
        CEMS.tick(cemsState.value, idx, 3);
        energyFrame.value = energy;
        frameIdx.value = (idx + 1) % 60;
        // 累计（每帧 3 秒）
        cumulativeToday.value = cemsState.value.cumulative;
        // 双轴曲线滚动窗口
        const win = curveWindow.value;
        win.push({
          t: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour12: false }),
          load: +energy.powerKw.toFixed(1),        // 用电负荷 kW
          carbon: +cemsState.value.instantRate.toFixed(3),  // 烟气碳排 tCO₂/h
        });
        if (win.length > 30) win.shift();
      }

      /* ---- 拉取真实链上最近 5 笔存证 ---- */
      async function loadChain() {
        try {
          const page = await App.API.request('GET', '/chain/blocks?pageSize=5', null, { noAuth: true });
          chainBlocks.value = (page.rows || []).slice(0, 5);
        } catch (e) { /* 静默，链上数据可能为空 */ }
        try {
          const st = await App.API.request('GET', '/chain/stats', null, { noAuth: true });
          chainStats.value = {
            height: st.height || 0,
            totalTxs: st.totalTxs || 0,
            difficulty: st.difficulty || 0,
            nodes: st.nodeCount || 4,
          };
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      /* ---- HJ 212 原始报文抽屉 ---- */
      function openHj212() {
        const frame = CEMS.buildHj212(cemsState.value, new Date());
        const fp = CEMS.fingerprint(frame.packet);
        const sig = CEMS.gatewaySign(frame.packet);
        hjModal.packet = frame.packet;
        hjModal.crc = frame.crc;
        hjModal.body = frame.body;
        hjModal.sm3 = fp.sm3 || '(SM3 未就绪)';
        hjModal.sig = sig;
        hjModal.fields = frame.fields;
        hjModal.show = true;
      }

      /* ---- 点击 TxHash 触发验真抽屉（复用全局 showChainProof） ---- */
      function verifyBlock(b) {
        if (b && b.block_index !== undefined) {
          App.showChainProof('区块 #' + b.block_index, '/chain/blocks/' + b.block_index);
        }
      }

      /* ---- 自定义探针抽屉（备用，直接调 /chain/tx/:txId） ---- */
      async function openProbe(txId) {
        probeModal.show = true; probeModal.loading = true; probeModal.txId = txId; probeModal.data = null; probeModal.error = '';
        try {
          probeModal.data = await App.API.request('GET', '/chain/tx/' + txId, null, { noAuth: true });
        } catch (e) { probeModal.error = e.message; }
        finally { probeModal.loading = false; }
      }

      /* ---- 导出产品数字护照 ---- */
      function exportDPP() {
        const s = cemsState.value;
        const pf = SOURCES.powerFactors.national;
        const bom = BOM_SPLIT.map((b, i) => ({
          工序: point.value.bom[i] || b.stage,
          能耗占比: (b.energyPct * 100).toFixed(1) + '%',
          碳排占比: (b.carbonPct * 100).toFixed(1) + '%',
          实时功率_kW: +(energyFrame.value.powerKw * b.energyPct).toFixed(1),
          瞬时碳排_tCO2h: +(s.instantRate * b.carbonPct).toFixed(4),
        }));
        const dpp = {
          '产品数字护照': '碳链通 · 工业碳资产动态核算可信存证平台',
          '平台版本': 'v2.0 CarbonMatrix',
          '点位': point.value.name,
          '点位编码': point.value.code,
          '设备DID': point.value.did,
          '工艺路线': point.value.process,
          '采样时刻': new Date().toISOString(),
          '瞬时排碳速率_tCO2h': +s.instantRate.toFixed(4),
          '今日累计存证_tCO2': +s.cumulative.toFixed(4),
          '标态烟气流量_m3h': Math.round(s.flow),
          'CO2体积浓度_pct': s.co2Pct,
          '烟温_℃': s.temp,
          '动态碳折算因子': pf.value,
          '因子文号': pf.ref,
          '因子数据年度': pf.dataYear,
          '链高度': chainStats.value.height,
          '链上存证总数': chainStats.value.totalTxs,
          '共识节点数': chainStats.value.nodes,
          '国密算法': 'SM2/SM3',
          'BOM碳分摊': bom,
          '防篡改证据链': ['物理表计采样', '硬件芯片SM2签名', '智能合约核算', '权威节点共识确认'],
        };
        const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(dpp, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url; a.download = 'DPP-' + point.value.code + '-' + Date.now() + '.json';
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        App.notify && App.notify.info && App.notify.info('产品数字护照已导出（JSON）');
      }

      /* ---- 双轴联动曲线 option ---- */
      const curveOption = computed(() => {
        const win = curveWindow.value;
        if (!win.length) return null;
        return App.chartBase({
          legend: { data: ['用电负荷', '烟气碳排'], textStyle: { color: '#8d9cb5', fontSize: 11.5 }, top: 0, right: 8 },
          grid: { left: 10, right: 20, top: 34, bottom: 6, containLabel: true },
          tooltip: Object.assign(App.chartBase().tooltip, {
            trigger: 'axis',
            formatter: (ps) => {
              const p0 = ps[0], p1 = ps[1];
              return `<b>${p0.axisValue}</b><br/>` +
                `用电负荷：<b style="color:#1890FF">${p0 ? p0.value : '-'} kW</b><br/>` +
                `烟气碳排：<b style="color:#00C07F">${p1 ? p1.value : '-'} tCO₂/h</b>`;
            },
          }),
          xAxis: App.catAxis(win.map((w) => w.t), { boundaryGap: false }),
          yAxis: [
            App.valAxis({ name: 'kW', nameTextStyle: { color: '#1890FF', fontSize: 10.5 }, splitLine: { show: true, lineStyle: { color: 'rgba(24,144,255,.08)' } } }),
            App.valAxis({ name: 'tCO₂/h', nameTextStyle: { color: '#00C07F', fontSize: 10.5 }, splitLine: { show: false } }),
          ],
          series: [
            {
              name: '用电负荷', type: 'line', smooth: true, symbol: 'circle', symbolSize: 4,
              data: win.map((w) => w.load),
              lineStyle: { width: 2.4, color: '#1890FF' }, itemStyle: { color: '#1890FF' },
              areaStyle: { color: App.areaGrad('rgba(24,144,255,.28)', 'rgba(24,144,255,.02)') },
            },
            {
              name: '烟气碳排', type: 'line', yAxisIndex: 1, smooth: true, symbol: 'circle', symbolSize: 4,
              data: win.map((w) => w.carbon),
              lineStyle: { width: 2.4, color: '#00C07F' }, itemStyle: { color: '#00C07F' },
              areaStyle: { color: App.areaGrad('rgba(0,192,127,.28)', 'rgba(0,192,127,.02)') },
            },
          ],
        });
      });

      /* ---- BOM 工序分摊数据 ---- */
      const bomRows = computed(() => {
        const s = cemsState.value;
        const energy = energyFrame.value;
        return BOM_SPLIT.map((b, i) => ({
          stage: point.value.bom[i] || b.stage,
          desc: b.desc,
          energyPct: b.energyPct,
          carbonPct: b.carbonPct,
          powerKw: +(energy.powerKw * b.energyPct).toFixed(1),
          carbonRate: +(s.instantRate * b.carbonPct).toFixed(4),
        }));
      });

      /* ---- 链上存证表格行（映射规范字段） ---- */
      const chainRows = computed(() => {
        const s = cemsState.value;
        return chainBlocks.value.map((b) => ({
          batch: 'B' + String(b.block_index).padStart(6, '0'),
          point: point.value.code,
          carbon: +s.instantRate.toFixed(4),
          did: point.value.did.slice(-16),
          txHash: b.block_hash,
          blockIndex: b.block_index,
          time: b.block_time,
          txCount: b.tx_count,
        }));
      });

      /* ---- 生命周期 ---- */
      onMounted(() => {
        // 立即推进一帧 + 拉链
        advanceFrame();
        loadChain();
        // 每 3 秒推进归档序列
        frameTimer = setInterval(advanceFrame, 3000);
        // 每 30 秒刷新链上数据
        blockTimer = setInterval(loadChain, 30000);
      });
      onUnmounted(() => {
        clearInterval(frameTimer);
        clearInterval(blockTimer);
      });

      /* ---- 渲染 ---- */
      return () => {
        const s = cemsState.value;
        const energy = energyFrame.value;
        const pf = SOURCES.powerFactors.national;
        const bom = bomRows.value;
        const rows = chainRows.value;

        return h('div', { class: 'matrix' }, [
          /* ===== 顶部全局状态栏 ===== */
          h('div', { class: 'matrix-head' }, [
            h('div', { class: 'matrix-head-left' }, [
              h('div', { class: 'brand-logo', style: 'width:48px;height:26px' }, [h('img', { src: './img/logo-mark.png', alt: '碳链通' })]),
              h('div', { class: 'matrix-title-block' }, [
                h('h1', { class: 'matrix-title' }, '碳链通 · 工业碳资产动态核算可信存证平台'),
                h('div', { class: 'matrix-sub' }, 'Carbon Matrix · 联盟链碳资产动态核算 · 国密 SM2/SM3 验签'),
              ]),
            ]),
            h('div', { class: 'matrix-head-mid' }, [
              h('div', { class: 'matrix-point' }, [
                h('label', { class: 'matrix-point-label' }, '点位'),
                h('select', {
                  class: 'matrix-point-sel',
                  value: pointIdx.value,
                  onChange: (e) => { pointIdx.value = +e.target.value; },
                }, POINTS.map((p, i) => h('option', { value: i }, p.name))),
              ]),
              h('div', { class: 'matrix-leds' }, [
                h('div', { class: 'matrix-led led-green' }, [h('i', { class: 'led-dot' }), h('span', {}, 'HJ 212-2017 工业流在线')]),
                h('div', { class: 'matrix-led led-blue' }, [h('i', { class: 'led-dot' }), h('span', {}, 'DL/T 645 电力数据直连')]),
              ]),
            ]),
            h('div', { class: 'matrix-head-right' }, [
              h('div', { class: 'matrix-chain' }, [
                h('x-icon', { name: 'chain', size: 16 }),
                h('div', { class: 'matrix-chain-info' }, [
                  h('div', { class: 'matrix-chain-h mono' }, 'Block #' + (chainStats.value.height || '—').toLocaleString()),
                  h('div', { class: 'matrix-chain-sub' }, chainStats.value.nodes + ' 节点共识 · 国密 SM2/SM3 验签通过'),
                ]),
              ]),
            ]),
          ]),

          /* ===== KPI 四卡 ===== */
          h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
            h('x-kpi', {
              label: '瞬时排碳速率', value: s.instantRate.toFixed(4), unit: 'tCO₂/h',
              icon: 'fire', tone: 'carbon',
              foot: 'Q=' + Math.round(s.flow) + ' m³/h · φ=' + s.co2Pct + '%',
            }),
            h('x-kpi', {
              label: '今日累计存证总量', value: cumulativeToday.value.toFixed(3), unit: 'tCO₂',
              icon: 'shield', tone: 'chain',
              foot: '链高度 #' + (chainStats.value.height || '—') + ' · ' + chainStats.value.totalTxs + ' 笔存证',
            }),
            h('x-kpi', {
              label: '标态烟气流量', value: Math.round(s.flow).toLocaleString(), unit: 'm³/h',
              icon: 'factory', tone: 'sky',
              foot: '烟温 ' + s.temp + '℃ · 含氧 ' + s.o2Pct + '% · 烟压 ' + s.pressure + 'Pa',
            }),
            h('x-kpi', {
              label: '动态碳折算因子', value: pf.value.toFixed(4), unit: 'tCO₂/MWh',
              icon: 'leaf', tone: 'violet',
              foot: pf.ref + ' · ' + pf.dataYear + ' 年度',
            }),
          ]),

          /* ===== 双轴联动曲线 + BOM 碳分摊 ===== */
          h('div', { class: 'grid g-3-2 mb-16' }, [
            h('x-card', {
              title: '用电负荷 vs 烟气碳排动态耦合', sub: '双轴联动 · 滚动窗口 90 秒（30 帧 × 3s）',
              actions: () => h('span', { class: 'chip live mono' }, '实时'),
            }, {
              default: () => h('x-chart', { option: curveOption.value, height: 'h340' }),
            }),
            h('x-card', {
              title: '工序级 BOM 碳分摊流水', sub: point.value.process + ' · ' + point.value.bom.join(' → '),
            }, {
              default: () => h('div', { class: 'bom-flow' }, bom.map((b, i) => {
                const maxCarbon = Math.max(...bom.map((x) => x.carbonRate), 0.001);
                const widthPct = (b.carbonRate / maxCarbon * 100).toFixed(1);
                return h('div', { class: 'bom-step' }, [
                  h('div', { class: 'bom-step-head' }, [
                    h('div', { class: 'bom-step-idx mono' }, String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')),
                    h('div', { class: 'bom-step-name' }, b.stage),
                    h('div', { class: 'bom-step-pct mono' }, (b.carbonPct * 100).toFixed(0) + '%'),
                  ]),
                  h('div', { class: 'bom-step-desc tiny dim' }, b.desc),
                  h('div', { class: 'bom-bar' }, [
                    h('div', { class: 'bom-bar-fill', style: 'width:' + widthPct + '%' }),
                  ]),
                  h('div', { class: 'bom-step-meta mono tiny' }, [
                    h('span', {}, '功率 ' + b.powerKw + ' kW'),
                    h('span', { style: 'margin-left:12px' }, '碳排 ' + b.carbonRate + ' tCO₂/h'),
                  ]),
                  i < bom.length - 1 ? h('div', { class: 'bom-arrow' }, '↓') : null,
                ]);
              })),
            }),
          ]),

          /* ===== 链上存证表格 + 操作 ===== */
          h('div', { class: 'grid g-2-1' }, [
            h('x-card', {
              title: '最新 5 笔上链存证记录', sub: '点击 TxHash 打开穿透式核验报告抽屉', flush: true,
            }, {
              actions: () => h('div', { class: 'flex gap-8' }, [
                h('button', { class: 'btn sm ghost', onClick: openHj212 }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'report', size: 13 }), 'HJ 212 报文']),
                h('button', { class: 'btn sm ghost', onClick: loadChain }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'refresh', size: 13 }), '刷新']),
              ]),
              default: () => h('div', { class: 'card-body' }, [
                h('x-table', {
                  columns: [
                    { key: 'batch', title: '批次号', width: '110px' },
                    { key: 'point', title: '点位', width: '110px' },
                    { key: 'carbon', title: '折算碳量(tCO₂/h)', align: 'right' },
                    { key: 'did', title: '设备 DID' },
                    { key: 'txHash', title: 'TxHash' },
                  ],
                  rows: rows,
                  rowKey: 'batch',
                  rowClick: (row) => verifyBlock({ block_index: row.blockIndex }),
                  empty: '链上暂无存证记录',
                }, {
                  'col-txHash': ({ row }) => h('span', { class: 'mono tiny hash-link', title: row.txHash }, App.fmt.short(row.txHash, 16)),
                  'col-did': ({ row }) => h('span', { class: 'mono tiny' }, row.did),
                  'col-carbon': ({ row }) => h('span', { class: 'mono', style: 'color:#00C07F' }, row.carbon),
                  'col-batch': ({ row }) => h('span', { class: 'mono' }, row.batch),
                }),
              ]),
            }),
            h('div', { class: 'col gap-16' }, [
              h('x-card', { title: '设备 DID 与网关状态', sub: point.value.name }, {
                default: () => h('dl', { class: 'kv', style: 'grid-template-columns:88px 1fr' }, [
                  h('dt', {}, '设备 DID'), h('dd', { class: 'hashbox mono tiny' }, point.value.did),
                  h('dt', {}, '工艺路线'), h('dd', {}, point.value.process),
                  h('dt', {}, '采样频率'), h('dd', { class: 'mono' }, 'CEMS 3s / 电表 1s'),
                  h('dt', {}, '网关状态'), h('dd', {}, [h('span', { class: 'tag t-ok' }, 'TEE 在线')]),
                  h('dt', {}, '报文协议'), h('dd', {}, [h('span', { class: 'tag t-info' }, 'HJ 212-2017')]),
                  h('dt', {}, '电力协议'), h('dd', {}, [h('span', { class: 'tag t-info' }, 'DL/T 645-2007')]),
                ]),
              }),
              h('x-card', { title: '防篡改证据链', sub: '四级存证 · 穿透式核验' }, {
                default: () => h('div', { class: 'col gap-8' }, [
                  ['1. 物理表计采样', '2. 硬件芯片 SM2 签名', '3. 智能合约核算', '4. 权威节点共识确认'].map((t) =>
                    h('div', { class: 'proof-step' }, [h('i', { class: 'proof-dot' }), h('span', {}, t)])),
                  h('button', { class: 'btn primary mt-12', onClick: exportDPP }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'report', size: 14 }), '导出产品数字护照']),
                ]),
              }),
            ]),
          ]),

          /* ===== HJ 212 报文抽屉 ===== */
          h('x-modal', {
            modelValue: hjModal.show,
            title: 'HJ 212-2017 原始工业报文帧 · ' + point.value.code,
            width: '760px',
            'onUpdate:modelValue': (v) => { hjModal.show = v; },
          }, {
            default: () => hjModal.packet ? h('div', { class: 'hj212-frame' }, [
              h('div', { class: 'alertbar info mb-16' }, [
                h('x-icon', { name: 'info', size: 15 }),
                '符合生态环境部 HJ 212-2017《污染物在线监控（监测）系统数据传输标准》',
              ]),
              h('div', { class: 'grid g2 mb-16' }, [
                h('div', {}, [
                  h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mb-8' }, '完整报文帧'),
                  h('pre', { class: 'mono-pre hj212-packet' }, hjModal.packet),
                ]),
                h('div', { class: 'col gap-12' }, [
                  h('div', {}, [
                    h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mb-8' }, 'CRC16 校验和'),
                    h('div', { class: 'mono hj212-crc' }, hjModal.crc),
                  ]),
                  h('div', {}, [
                    h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mb-8' }, 'SM3 摘要指纹（报文防篡改）'),
                    h('div', { class: 'mono hj212-sm3' }, hjModal.sm3),
                  ]),
                  h('div', {}, [
                    h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mb-8' }, '网关 SM2 签名'),
                    h('div', { class: 'mono hj212-sig' }, hjModal.sig),
                  ]),
                ]),
              ]),
              h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mb-8' }, '数据段字段（CP=&& ... &&）'),
              h('pre', { class: 'mono-pre hj212-body' }, hjModal.body),
              hjModal.fields ? h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mt-16' }, [
                h('div', { class: 'kv-mini' }, [h('span', { class: 'dim tiny' }, 'CO₂'), h('b', { class: 'mono' }, hjModal.fields.co2 + '%')]),
                h('div', { class: 'kv-mini' }, [h('span', { class: 'dim tiny' }, '流量'), h('b', { class: 'mono' }, Math.round(hjModal.fields.flow) + ' m³/h')]),
                h('div', { class: 'kv-mini' }, [h('span', { class: 'dim tiny' }, '烟温'), h('b', { class: 'mono' }, hjModal.fields.temp + '℃')]),
                h('div', { class: 'kv-mini' }, [h('span', { class: 'dim tiny' }, '含氧'), h('b', { class: 'mono' }, hjModal.fields.o2 + '%')]),
              ]) : null,
            ]) : h('div', { class: 'skel', style: 'height:200px' }),
            footer: () => [
              h('button', { class: 'btn', onClick: () => { hjModal.show = false; } }, '关闭'),
              h('button', { class: 'btn chain', onClick: exportDPP }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'report', size: 14 }), '导出数字护照']),
            ],
          }),
        ]);
      };
    },
  });

  App.views = App.views || {};
  App.views['page-matrix'] = PageMatrix;
})();

/* ================================================================
 * 文件：public/js/views/ops.js
 * ================================================================ */
/* =====================================================================
   ops.js —— 生产运维监控中心（监控告警 / 结构化日志 / 灰度发布）
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   生产加固的运维入口，实时展示：
     · QPS / P50 / P95 / P99 / 错误率 / uptime（每 3 秒刷新）
     · 实时 QPS 折线图（ECharts，滚动窗口 40 点）
     · 告警事件流（每 5 秒拉取）
     · 结构化日志流（按级别过滤，每 4 秒拉取）
     · 灰度功能开关列表（可切换）
   ===================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const { defineComponent, ref, reactive, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } = Vue;
  const h = App.h;

  const STYLE_ID = 'ops-page-style';
  function injectStyle() {
    if (document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)) return;
    const css = `
.ops-mono{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.7;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all}
.ops-log{max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;line-height:1.6}
.ops-log .lv-info{color:var(--tx-2)}
.ops-log .lv-warn{color:var(--warn)}
.ops-log .lv-error{color:var(--danger)}
.ops-log .lv-debug{color:var(--tx-3)}
.ops-log .row{padding:2px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.ops-flag{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.ops-flag.on{border-color:var(--brand);background:rgba(0,192,127,.06)}
`;
    const el = document.createElement('style');
    el.id = STYLE_ID;
    el.textContent = css;
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  }

  const PageOps = defineComponent({
    name: 'page-ops',
    setup() {
      injectStyle();
      const stats = ref({ qps: 0, p50: 0, p95: 0, p99: 0, errorRate: 0, totalRequests: 0, uptime: 0, memoryMB: 0, samples: 0 });
      const alerts = ref([]);
      const logs = ref([]);
      const logLevel = ref('');
      const logQuery = ref('');
      const canaryStatus = ref(null);
      const qpsSeries = ref([]);  // 滚动窗口
      const QPS_CAP = 40;

      let statsTimer = null, alertTimer = null, logTimer = null, chartTimer = null;
      let chart = null, chartEl = null;

      async function fetchStats() {
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/api/ops/stats');
          const j = await r.json();
          if (j && j.data) {
            stats.value = j.data;
            qpsSeries.value.push({ t: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN'), v: j.data.qps });
            if (qpsSeries.value.length > QPS_CAP) qpsSeries.value.shift();
            updateChart();
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      async function fetchAlerts() {
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/api/ops/alerts');
          const j = await r.json();
          if (j && j.data) alerts.value = j.data.alerts || [];
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      async function fetchLogs() {
        try {
          const p = new URLSearchParams({ limit: '50' });
          if (logLevel.value) p.set('level', logLevel.value);
          if (logQuery.value) p.set('q', logQuery.value);
          const r = await fetch('/api/ops/logs?' + p.toString());
          const j = await r.json();
          if (j && j.data) logs.value = j.data.entries || [];
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      async function fetchCanary() {
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/api/ops/canary');
          const j = await r.json();
          if (j && j.data) canaryStatus.value = j.data;
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      async function toggleFlag(key, enabled) {
        try {
          const token = localStorage.getItem('cch_token');
          const r = await fetch('/api/ops/canary', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: token ? 'Bearer ' + token : '' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ feature: key, enabled: !enabled }),
          });
          const j = await r.json();
          if (j && j.code === 0) { fetchCanary(); }
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function initChart(el) {
        if (!el || typeof echarts === 'undefined') return;
        chartEl = el;
        chart = echarts.init(el);
        chart.setOption({
          grid: { left: 50, right: 20, top: 20, bottom: 30 },
          xAxis: { type: 'category', data: [], axisLabel: { color: '#8a94a6', fontSize: 10 } },
          yAxis: { type: 'value', axisLabel: { color: '#8a94a6', fontSize: 10 }, splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.06)' } } },
          series: [{ name: 'QPS', type: 'line', smooth: true, symbol: 'none', data: [],
            lineStyle: { color: '#00c07f', width: 2 }, areaStyle: { color: { type: 'linear', x: 0, y: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1, colorStops: [
              { offset: 0, color: 'rgba(0,192,127,.3)' }, { offset: 1, color: 'rgba(0,192,127,0)' }] } } }],
          tooltip: { trigger: 'axis' },
        });
      }
      function updateChart() {
        if (!chart) return;
        chart.setOption({
          xAxis: { data: qpsSeries.value.map((p) => p.t) },
          series: [{ data: qpsSeries.value.map((p) => p.v) }],
        });
      }

      onMounted(() => {
        fetchStats(); fetchAlerts(); fetchLogs(); fetchCanary();
        statsTimer = setInterval(fetchStats, 3000);
        alertTimer = setInterval(fetchAlerts, 5000);
        logTimer = setInterval(fetchLogs, 4000);
      });
      onUnmounted(() => {
        if (statsTimer) clearInterval(statsTimer);
        if (alertTimer) clearInterval(alertTimer);
        if (logTimer) clearInterval(logTimer);
        if (chart) { chart.dispose(); chart = null; }
      });

      function kpis() {
        return h('div', { class: 'grid g4 mb-16' }, [
          h('x-kpi', { label: '实时 QPS', value: stats.value.qps, unit: 'req/s', tone: 'chain', icon: 'chart', foot: `总请求 ${stats.value.totalRequests}` }),
          h('x-kpi', { label: 'P95 延迟', value: stats.value.p95, unit: 'ms', tone: stats.value.p95 > 2000 ? 'rose' : 'carbon', icon: 'clock',
            foot: `P50 ${stats.value.p50} · P99 ${stats.value.p99}` }),
          h('x-kpi', { label: '错误率', value: stats.value.errorRate, unit: '%', tone: stats.value.errorRate > 5 ? 'rose' : 'sky', icon: 'warn',
            foot: `错误 0 / ${stats.value.totalRequests} 请求` }),
          h('x-kpi', { label: '进程运行', value: stats.value.uptime, unit: '秒', tone: 'violet', icon: 'block',
            foot: `内存 ${stats.value.memoryMB} MB · Node ${stats.value.nodeVersion || ''}` }),
        ]);
      }

      function monitorCard() {
        return h('x-card', { title: '实时 QPS 监控', sub: '每 3 秒采样 · Prometheus 兼容指标 /api/ops/metrics', flush: true }, {
          actions: () => h('a', { class: 'btn sm ghost', href: '/api/ops/metrics', target: '_blank' }, 'Prometheus 指标'),
          default: () => h('div', { style: 'padding:14px 16px' }, [
            h('div', { ref: initChart, style: 'width:100%;height:240px' }),
            h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mt-12', style: 'line-height:1.7' }, [
              '指标接口：GET /api/ops/metrics（Prometheus text format）· GET /api/ops/stats（JSON）· GET /api/ops/alerts（告警事件流）。'
              + '生产环境可由 Prometheus 抓取 /api/ops/metrics，Grafana 配置告警与可视化看板。'
              + '当前节点：' + (stats.value.nodeVersion || '—') + ' · 采样数 ' + stats.value.samples + '。',
            ]),
          ]),
        });
      }

      function alertCard() {
        return h('x-card', { title: '告警事件流', sub: '阈值规则：P95>2000ms WARN · P99>5000ms CRIT · 错误率>5% CRIT', flush: true }, {
          default: () => h('div', { style: 'padding:12px 16px;max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto' }, [
            alerts.value.length === 0 ? h('div', { class: 'empty' }, [
              h('div', { class: 'empty-mark' }, [h('x-icon', { name: 'check', size: 30 })]),
              h('div', { class: 'empty-title' }, '无告警 · 所有指标正常'),
            ]) : h('div', {}, alerts.value.map((a) => h('div', {
              class: ['ops-flag', a.severity === 'CRIT' ? '' : 'on'].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
              style: a.severity === 'CRIT' ? 'border-color:var(--danger);background:rgba(216,90,48,.06)' : '',
            }, [
              h('div', {}, [
                h('span', { class: ['tag', a.severity === 'CRIT' ? 'warn' : 'ok'] }, a.severity),
                h('span', { style: 'margin-left:8px;font-weight:500' }, a.message),
              ]),
              h('div', { class: 'tiny dim mono' }, `${a.ts} · 当前 ${a.value} > 阈值 ${a.threshold} · 规则 ${a.rule}`),
            ]))),
          ]),
        });
      }

      function logCard() {
        return h('x-card', { title: '结构化日志流', sub: 'JSON 格式 · 环形缓冲 1000 条 · 按 level/q 过滤', flush: true }, {
          actions: () => h('div', { class: 'flex gap-6' }, [
            h('select', {
              class: 'btn sm ghost',
              value: logLevel.value,
              onChange: (e) => { logLevel.value = e.target.value; fetchLogs(); },
            }, [
              h('option', { value: '' }, '全部级别'),
              h('option', { value: 'info' }, 'INFO'),
              h('option', { value: 'warn' }, 'WARN'),
              h('option', { value: 'error' }, 'ERROR'),
            ]),
            h('input', {
              class: 'btn sm ghost',
              placeholder: '关键字过滤...',
              value: logQuery.value,
              onInput: (e) => { logQuery.value = e.target.value; },
              onChange: () => fetchLogs(),
              style: 'width:140px',
            }),
          ]),
          default: () => h('div', { class: 'ops-log', style: 'padding:10px 16px' },
            logs.value.length === 0 ? h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '暂无日志') :
            logs.value.map((e) => h('div', { class: 'row lv-' + e.level }, [
              h('span', { class: 'mono', style: 'color:var(--tx-3)' }, e.ts.slice(11, 19) + ' '),
              h('span', { class: 'mono', style: 'margin-right:6px;font-weight:500' }, '[' + (e.level || 'info').toUpperCase() + ']'),
              h('span', {}, e.message + (e.path ? ' ' + e.method + ' ' + e.path + ' ' + e.status + ' ' + e.durationMs + 'ms' : '')),
            ]))),
        });
      }

      function canaryCard() {
        return h('x-card', { title: '灰度发布 · 功能开关', sub: '?canary=1 或 X-Canary: true header 路由到灰度逻辑' }, {
          default: () => h('div', { style: 'padding:12px 16px' },
            canaryStatus.value && canaryStatus.value.features
              ? Object.entries(canaryStatus.value.features).map(([key, f]) => h('div', {
                  class: ['ops-flag', f.enabled ? 'on' : ''].join(' '),
                }, [
                  h('div', {}, [
                    h('div', { style: 'font-weight:500;font-size:13px' }, key),
                    h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, f.desc + ' · 上线 ' + f.since),
                  ]),
                  h('div', { class: 'flex gap-6', style: 'align-items:center' }, [
                    h('span', { class: ['tag', f.enabled ? 'ok' : ''] }, f.enabled ? '已开启' : '已关闭'),
                    h('button', {
                      class: ['btn', 'xs', f.enabled ? 'ghost' : 'primary'],
                      onClick: () => toggleFlag(key, f.enabled),
                    }, f.enabled ? '关闭' : '开启'),
                  ]),
                ]))
              : h('div', { class: 'tiny dim' }, '正在加载灰度状态…'),
          ),
        });
      }

      return () => h('x-page', {
        title: '生产运维监控中心',
        desc: '监控告警 / 结构化日志 / 灰度发布 · 生产加固基础设施',
      }, {
        default: () => h('div', { class: 'col gap-16' }, [
          kpis(),
          monitorCard(),
          h('div', { class: 'grid g-2-1' }, [alertCard(), logCard()]),
          canaryCard(),
        ]),
      });
    },
  });

  App.views['page-ops'] = PageOps;
})();

/* ================================================================
 * 文件：scripts/uncertainty.js
 * ================================================================ */
/**
 * scripts/uncertainty.js —— 核算与不确定度内核的离线复算（可复现证据）
 * ==================================================================
 * 本脚本把 `public/js/data/nucleus.js` 的核算内核搬到 Node 下**真实跑一遍**，
 * 产出可复核的数字，回答六个问题：
 *
 *   1. 台账自洽吗？        —— Tier 1 缺省法 vs Tier 2 参数展开法，13 项燃料逐项对账
 *   2. 产品碳闭合吗？      —— Σ(工序 BOM 分摊) 与 范围一+范围二 是否都等于批次总量
 *   3. 组织碳算得出来吗？    —— 由在网设备读数 × 声明运行日历，逐企业积分
 *   4. 双轨对账站得住吗？    —— 组织碳 ⊇ Σ产品碳 的包含性硬约束 + 存证覆盖率归因
 *   5. 判据会不会永远通过？  —— 负向注入（falsification）：故意制造 4 类错误，验证判据会报警
 *   6. 不确定度可信吗？     —— 蒙特卡洛（10000 次抽样）vs 解析解（误差传播律）互证
 *
 * 产出：
 *   · artifacts/bench/nucleus.json       原始结果
 *   · artifacts/bench/nucleus-report.md  Markdown 报告
 *
 * 用法：node scripts/uncertainty.js [迭代次数]
 */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

/* industry.js / sources.js / nucleus.js 都以 window 为宿主，这里造一个 */
global.window = global;

const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..');
/* 注意加载顺序：sources → nucleus → industry。
 * industry.js 只把结果挂到 global.App.Industry，没有 module.exports，
 * 因此 require 只用于触发副作用，取值必须走 global.App。 */
const Sources = require(path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'js', 'data', 'sources.js'));
const Nucleus = require(path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'js', 'data', 'nucleus.js'));
require(path.join(ROOT, 'public', 'js', 'data', 'industry.js'));
const Industry = global.App.Industry;
if (!Industry || !Industry.devices) {
  throw new Error('[uncertainty] 未能加载 App.Industry（检查 industry.js 是否挂在 window/globalThis）');
}

const ITER = Math.max(1000, Number(process.argv[2]) || 10000);
const r2 = (x) => Math.round(x * 100) / 100;
const r4 = (x) => Math.round(x * 10000) / 10000;
const r1 = (x) => Math.round(x * 10) / 10;

/* 声明核算期与运行日历（在线率由在网设备工况状态折算，不用魔数） */
const CALENDAR = Nucleus.productionCalendar({
  periodCn: '2026Q3',
  days: 92,
  hoursPerDay: 24,
  devices: Industry.devices,
});

/* 辅助用能与输配损耗的声明比例（工程典型值，可在企业档案中按行业覆盖） */
const AUX_SHARE = 0.055;   // 辅助生产 / 办公 / 厂内运输等未分摊到产品的用能
const LOSS_SHARE = 0.08;   // 输配损耗 + 计量器具超差 + 未计量逸散

/* ==================================================================
 * 1. 台账自洽性：Tier1 vs Tier2 逐项对账
 * ================================================================== */
function checkLedgerConsistency() {
  const rows = Sources.fuelFactors
    .filter((f) => f.traceLevel !== 'C')
    .map((f) => {
      const d = Nucleus.dualPathFuel(f.code, 1, Sources);
      return {
        code: f.code, cn: f.cn,
        tier1: r4(d.tier1.value),
        tier2: r4(d.tier2.value),
        differencePct: r4(d.differencePct),
        consistent: d.consistent,
      };
    });
  const maxDev = rows.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, Math.abs(r.differencePct)), 0);
  return {
    rows, maxDeviationPct: r4(maxDev),
    allConsistent: rows.every((r) => r.consistent),
    note: 'Tier 1 直接用台账公布的缺省因子；Tier 2 用同一组（NCV, CC, OF）从 IPCC 原始算式重算。'
      + '两者一致 ⇒ 台账数值与其宣称的原始算式自洽，不存在“因子与参数对不上”的隐性错误。',
  };
}

/* ==================================================================
 * 2. 产品碳内部闭合（Tier 1 强判据）
 * ================================================================== */
function checkPcfClosure() {
  const all = Industry.batches || [];
  const c = Nucleus.pcfInternalClosure(all, 0.5);
  return Object.assign({}, c, {
    note: c.note + ' 判据口径：PCF 核算边界仅含范围一 + 范围二，'
      + '上游原辅料以内置因子形式计入各工序，不单列范围三（GB/T 24067-2024 / ISO 14067）。',
  });
}

/* ==================================================================
 * 3. 组织碳核算（逐企业，按声明运行日历积分）
 * ================================================================== */
function computeOrg() {
  const entIds = Object.keys(Industry.ENTERPRISES).map(Number);
  const perEnterprise = entIds.map((id) => {
    const ent = Industry.ENTERPRISES[id];
    const devs = Industry.devicesOf(id);
    const measurable = devs.filter((d) => d.live
      && (d.live.powerKwh || d.live.gasNm3 || d.live.steamT));
    const period = Nucleus.meteredPeriodEmission(measurable, CALENDAR, Sources);
    return {
      entId: id, entName: ent.name, entShort: ent.short, industry: ent.industry, region: ent.region,
      devicesTotal: devs.length,
      devicesUsed: period.count,
      hourlyTotal: r4(period.hourlyTotal),
      periodTotal: r1(period.periodTotal),
      scope1: r1(period.scope1),
      scope2: r1(period.scope2),
      byKey: Object.keys(period.byKey).reduce((o, k) => { o[k] = r1(period.byKey[k]); return o; }, {}),
      metered: period.count > 0,
      reason: period.count > 0 ? null : '该企业在本期尚未接入计量设备，无法做组织碳核算',
      items: period.items.map((i) => ({
        scope: i.scope, key: i.key, cn: i.cn,
        quantity: i.quantity, unit: i.unit, factor: i.factor,
        tco2ePeriod: r1(i.tco2ePeriod), note: i.note || null,
      })),
    };
  });

  const metered = perEnterprise.filter((e) => e.metered);
  const sum = (arr, k) => arr.reduce((s, r) => s + (Number(r[k]) || 0), 0);
  return {
    calendar: CALENDAR,
    perEnterprise,
    devicesUsed: sum(perEnterprise, 'devicesUsed'),
    devicesTotal: sum(perEnterprise, 'devicesTotal'),
    meteredCount: metered.length,
    unmeteredCount: perEnterprise.length - metered.length,
    periodTotal: r1(sum(metered, 'periodTotal')),
    scope1: r1(sum(metered, 'scope1')),
    scope2: r1(sum(metered, 'scope2')),
    unit: `tCO₂e（${CALENDAR.periodCn} 期间累计口径，由瞬时读数 × ${CALENDAR.hours.toFixed(1)} 运行小时积分得到）`,
    note: '设备清单是企业在网计量点，不等同于企业完整排放边界；因此该值是'
      + '“已接入计量口径的组织碳”读用，而非企业全量排放。'
      + '未接入计量的企业单列，不用估算值填补。',
  };
}

/* ==================================================================
 * 4. 双轨对账（企业级包含性 + 存证覆盖率 + 联盟汇总）
 * ================================================================== */
function computeReconcile(org) {
  const entIds = Object.keys(Industry.ENTERPRISES).map(Number);
  const rows = entIds.map((id) => {
    const o = org.perEnterprise.find((x) => x.entId === id) || { periodTotal: 0, metered: false };
    const all = Industry.batchesOf(id) || [];
    const stored = all.filter((b) => b.status !== 'BLOCKED');
    const blocked = all.filter((b) => b.status === 'BLOCKED');
    const base = Nucleus.enterpriseReconcile({
      entId: id,
      entName: Industry.ENTERPRISES[id].name,
      industry: Industry.ENTERPRISES[id].industry,
      periodCn: CALENDAR.periodCn,
      orgTotal: o.periodTotal,
      batches: stored,
      auxShare: AUX_SHARE,
      lossShare: LOSS_SHARE,
    });
    return Object.assign(base, {
      metered: o.metered,
      reason: o.reason,
      blockedBatches: blocked.map((b) => b.batchNo),
      pcfSumTotalIncludingBlocked: r1(all.reduce((s, b) => s + b.totalTco2e, 0)),
    });
  });

  const league = Nucleus.leagueReconcile(rows);
  return {
    calendarCn: CALENDAR.periodCn,
    auxShare: AUX_SHARE,
    lossShare: LOSS_SHARE,
    rows: rows.map((r) => Object.assign({}, r, {
      orgTotal: r1(r.orgTotal), pcfSum: r1(r.pcfSum), allocatable: r1(r.allocatable),
      residual: r1(r.residual), coveragePct: r2(r.coveragePct),
    })),
    league: Object.assign({}, league, {
      orgTotal: r1(league.orgTotal), pcfSum: r1(league.pcfSum),
      allocatable: r1(league.allocatable), coveragePct: r2(league.coveragePct),
    }),
    note: '双轨对账的判据不是“两个数字相等”。组织碳刻画企业全部排放，产品碳只覆盖已存证的'
      + '部分批次，因此正确判据是：① 包含性（组织碳 ⊇ Σ产品碳，硬约束）；'
      + '② 可分摊空间 E_alloc = 组织碳 × (1 − 辅助率 − 损耗率)；'
      + '③ 存证覆盖率 ρ = Σ产品碳 / E_alloc。如实报告 ρ 而不是调参凑闭合，才是可被质证的做法。',
  };
}

/* ==================================================================
 * 5. 判据可证伪性验证（负向注入）
 *    证明上面的判据不是"永远通过"的空判据
 * ================================================================== */
function checkFalsification() {
  const cases = [];
  const tol = 0.5;

  /* 用例 A：篡改批次总量 → 应击破"范围一+范围二 === 总量"与"Σ工序 === 总量" */
  {
    const b = Industry.batches.find((x) => x.totalTco2e > 1000);
    const tampered = Object.assign({}, b, { totalTco2e: b.totalTco2e * 1.1 });
    const r = Nucleus.pcfInternalClosure([tampered], tol);
    cases.push({
      id: 'A', name: '篡改批次总碳足迹 +10%',
      inject: `${b.batchNo}：totalTco2e ${b.totalTco2e} → ${(b.totalTco2e * 1.1).toFixed(2)}`,
      expect: 'scopeDevPct / stageDevPct 超限 → FAIL',
      detected: !r.allPass,
      observed: `stageDevPct ${r.maxStageDevPct.toFixed(3)}% / scopeDevPct ${r.maxScopeDevPct.toFixed(3)}%`,
    });
  }

  /* 用例 B：只改范围二占比 → 应被"范围一+范围二 === 总量"抓到 */
  {
    const b = Industry.batches.find((x) => x.totalTco2e > 1000);
    const tampered = Object.assign({}, b, { scope2: b.scope2 * 0.6 });
    const r = Nucleus.pcfInternalClosure([tampered], tol);
    cases.push({
      id: 'B', name: '只改范围二占比（−40%）',
      inject: `${b.batchNo}：scope2 ${b.scope2} → ${(b.scope2 * 0.6).toFixed(2)}`,
      expect: 'scopeDevPct 超限 → FAIL',
      detected: !r.allPass,
      observed: `scopeDevPct ${r.maxScopeDevPct.toFixed(3)}%`,
    });
  }

  /* 用例 C：删掉一个工序分摊 → 应被"Σ工序 === 总量"抓到 */
  {
    const b = Industry.batches.find((x) => x.totalTco2e > 1000);
    const bom = Object.assign({}, b.bom, { stages: b.bom.stages.slice(0, 3) });
    const tampered = Object.assign({}, b, { bom });
    const r = Nucleus.pcfInternalClosure([tampered], tol);
    cases.push({
      id: 'C', name: '删除一个工序分摊段',
      inject: `${b.batchNo}：BOM 4 段 → 3 段`,
      expect: 'stageDevPct 超限 → FAIL',
      detected: !r.allPass,
      observed: `stageDevPct ${r.maxStageDevPct.toFixed(3)}%`,
    });
  }

  /* 用例 D：把产品碳放大到超过组织碳 → 应击破双轨包含性硬约束 */
  {
    const id = 2;
    const all = Industry.batchesOf(id).filter((x) => x.status !== 'BLOCKED');
    const inflate = all.map((x) => ({ batchNo: x.batchNo, product: x.product, totalTco2e: x.totalTco2e * 10 }));
    const norm = Nucleus.enterpriseReconcile({
      entId: id, orgTotal: 24095.84, batches: all, auxShare: AUX_SHARE, lossShare: LOSS_SHARE,
    });
    const bad = Nucleus.enterpriseReconcile({
      entId: id, orgTotal: 24095.84, batches: inflate, auxShare: AUX_SHARE, lossShare: LOSS_SHARE,
    });
    cases.push({
      id: 'D', name: '产品碳放大 10× 使其超过组织碳',
      inject: `ent 2：Σ产品碳 ${norm.pcfSum.toFixed(0)} → ${bad.pcfSum.toFixed(0)} tCO₂e`,
      expect: '包含性被击破 → FAIL（基线应 PASS）',
      detected: norm.pass && !bad.pass,
      observed: `基线 pass=${norm.pass}，注入后 pass=${bad.pass}，不可解释量 ${bad.unexplained.toFixed(1)} tCO₂e`,
    });
  }

  return {
    cases,
    total: cases.length,
    detectedCount: cases.filter((c) => c.detected).length,
    allDetected: cases.every((c) => c.detected),
    note: '负向注入是判据有效性的证明：如果判据在任何输入下都通过，它就不是判据。'
      + '本组用例故意破坏数据链路，要求校验逻辑必须报警 —— 报警即证明判据非空。',
  };
}

/* ==================================================================
 * 6. 蒙特卡洛 vs 解析解（双向互证）
 * ================================================================== */
function checkUncertainty(orgTotal) {
  /* 6.1 乘性模型：排放因子链（AD × NCV × CC × OF） */
  const p = Sources.uncertainty.parameters;
  const sig = (id, fb) => { const row = p.find((x) => x.id === id); return row ? row.sigmaRel : fb; };
  const chainInputs = [
    { id: 'AD', cn: '活动数据', value: 1, sigmaRel: sig('AD', 0.03) },
    { id: 'NCV', cn: '低位发热量', value: 1, sigmaRel: sig('NCV', 0.05) },
    { id: 'CC', cn: '单位热值含碳量', value: 1, sigmaRel: sig('CC', 0.05) },
    { id: 'OF', cn: '碳氧化率', value: 1, sigmaRel: sig('OF', 0.02) },
  ];
  const chainMC = Nucleus.monteCarlo(chainInputs, { model: 'product', iterations: ITER, seed: 20261011 });

  /* 6.2 加性模型：真实批次碳足迹总量 */
  const batch = (Industry.batches || []).find((b) => b.totalTco2e > 0) || { totalTco2e: 2000 };
  const batchMC = Nucleus.mcForBatch(batch.totalTco2e, { iterations: ITER, seed: 20261011, Sources });

  /* 6.3 动态电网法 vs 年均因子法（口径差异） */
  const oracle = Industry.oracle;
  const readings = oracle.series.map((pt, i) => ({
    kwh: 12000 + Math.sin(i / 3.1) * 2600 + i * 40,
    factor: pt.factor,
  }));
  const gridCmp = Nucleus.compareGridMethods(readings, oracle.baseline);

  return {
    iterations: ITER,
    chain: {
      model: 'product',
      inputs: chainInputs.map((i) => ({ id: i.id, cn: i.cn, sigmaRel: i.sigmaRel })),
      analyticSigmaRel: r4(chainMC.analytic.sigmaRel),
      mcSigmaRel: r4(chainMC.sigmaRel),
      crossCheckDiffPct: r2(chainMC.crossCheck.absDiffPct),
      p5: r4(chainMC.quantiles.p5),
      p50: r4(chainMC.quantiles.p50),
      p95: r4(chainMC.quantiles.p95),
      sensitivity: chainMC.sensitivity,
      recommendation: chainMC.recommendation,
      distribution: chainMC.distribution,
    },
    batch: {
      model: 'sum',
      batchNo: batch.batchNo,
      product: batch.product,
      central: r2(batchMC.central),
      mean: r2(batchMC.mean),
      sd: r2(batchMC.sd),
      sigmaRel: r4(batchMC.sigmaRel),
      analyticSigmaRel: r4(batchMC.analytic.sigmaRel),
      crossCheckDiffPct: r2(batchMC.crossCheck.absDiffPct),
      quantiles: { p5: r2(batchMC.quantiles.p5), p50: r2(batchMC.quantiles.p50), p95: r2(batchMC.quantiles.p95) },
      ci95: { lo: r2(batchMC.mean - 1.96 * batchMC.sd), hi: r2(batchMC.mean + 1.96 * batchMC.sd) },
      sensitivity: batchMC.sensitivity,
      recommendation: batchMC.recommendation,
      unit: 'tCO₂e',
    },
    gridMethod: {
      kwhTotal: r2(gridCmp.kwhTotal),
      dynamic: r2(gridCmp.dynamic),
      flat: r2(gridCmp.flat),
      difference: r2(gridCmp.difference),
      differencePct: r2(gridCmp.differencePct),
      effectiveFactor: r4(gridCmp.effectiveFactor),
      annualFactor: r4(gridCmp.annualFactor),
      interpretation: gridCmp.interpretation,
    },
  };
}

/* ==================================================================
 * 主流程
 * ================================================================== */
function main() {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  console.log('='.repeat(78));
  console.log(' 碳链通 · 核算算法与不确定度内核 —— 离线复算');
  console.log('='.repeat(78));
  console.log(` 蒙特卡洛迭代次数：${ITER.toLocaleString()}`);
  console.log(` 声明核算期：${CALENDAR.periodCn}　运行小时：${CALENDAR.hours.toFixed(1)} h`
    + `（${CALENDAR.days}d × ${CALENDAR.hoursPerDay}h × 在线率 ${(CALENDAR.availability * 100).toFixed(1)}%）`);
  console.log('-'.repeat(78));

  const ledger = checkLedgerConsistency();
  console.log(` ① 台账自洽性：${ledger.rows.length} 项燃料 Tier1/Tier2 对账，`
    + `最大偏差 ${ledger.maxDeviationPct}% → ${ledger.allConsistent ? '✅ 全部自洽' : '❌ 存在不一致'}`);

  const pcf = checkPcfClosure();
  console.log(` ② 产品碳内部闭合：${pcf.ok}/${pcf.total} 批次通过`
    + `（最大工序偏差 ${pcf.maxStageDevPct.toFixed(3)}% / 最大范围偏差 ${pcf.maxScopeDevPct.toFixed(3)}%）`
    + ` → ${pcf.allPass ? '✅ 全链路自洽' : '❌ 存在不闭合'}`);

  const org = computeOrg();
  console.log(` ③ 组织碳核算：${org.meteredCount} 家企业接入计量（${org.devicesUsed}/${org.devicesTotal} 台设备）`
    + ` → ${CALENDAR.periodCn} 期间 ${org.periodTotal.toLocaleString()} tCO₂e`
    + `（范围一 ${org.scope1.toLocaleString()} / 范围二 ${org.scope2.toLocaleString()}）`);
  if (org.unmeteredCount) console.log(`    未接入计量：${org.unmeteredCount} 家（不用估算值填补）`);

  const rec = computeReconcile(org);
  rec.rows.forEach((r) => {
    if (!r.metered) {
      console.log(` ④ 双轨对账 [${r.entName}] 跳过 —— ${r.reason}`);
    } else {
      console.log(` ④ 双轨对账 [${r.entName}] 组织碳 ${r.orgTotal.toLocaleString()} ⊇ 产品碳 ${r.pcfSum.toLocaleString()}`
        + ` → 覆盖率 ${r.coveragePct}% ${r.pass ? '✅ 包含性成立' : '❌ 包含性被击破'}`);
    }
  });
  console.log(` ④ 联盟级：${rec.league.meteredCount} 家已接入，Σ组织碳 ${rec.league.orgTotal.toLocaleString()}`
    + `，Σ产品碳 ${rec.league.pcfSum.toLocaleString()}，覆盖率 ${rec.league.coveragePct}%`
    + ` → ${rec.league.allPass ? '✅ 全部通过' : '❌ 存在击破'}`);

  const fal = checkFalsification();
  console.log(` ⑤ 判据可证伪性：${fal.detectedCount}/${fal.total} 类注入被检出`
    + ` → ${fal.allDetected ? '✅ 判据非空（会报警）' : '❌ 存在漏检'}`);

  const unc = checkUncertainty(org.periodTotal);
  console.log(` ⑥ 不确定度互证（乘性链）：解析 ${unc.chain.analyticSigmaRel} vs MC ${unc.chain.mcSigmaRel}，偏差 ${unc.chain.crossCheckDiffPct}%`);
  console.log(` ⑥ 不确定度互证（批次汇总）：解析 ${unc.batch.analyticSigmaRel} vs MC ${unc.batch.sigmaRel}，偏差 ${unc.batch.crossCheckDiffPct}%`);
  console.log(` ⑥ 电网因子口径差：动态法 ${unc.gridMethod.dynamic} vs 年均法 ${unc.gridMethod.flat} → 差 ${unc.gridMethod.differencePct}%`);

  const overallPass = ledger.allConsistent && pcf.allPass && rec.league.allPass
    && fal.allDetected && unc.chain.crossCheckDiffPct < 5 && unc.batch.crossCheckDiffPct < 5;
  console.log('-'.repeat(78));
  console.log(` 综合结论：${overallPass ? '✅ 六项验证全部通过' : '⚠ 存在未通过项，见上方明细'}`);
  console.log('-'.repeat(78));

  const payload = {
    meta: {
      title: '核算算法与不确定度内核 · 离线复算',
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      iterations: ITER,
      elapsedSec: r1((Date.now() - t0) / 1000),
      seed: 20261011,
      method: 'node scripts/uncertainty.js（复用 public/js/data/nucleus.js 真实内核）',
      determinism: '全部随机数来自 mulberry32 固定种子 20261011，跨机器结果完全一致，可复核。',
      overallPass,
    },
    ledgerConsistency: ledger,
    pcfClosure: pcf,
    organizationCarbon: org,
    dualTrackReconcile: rec,
    falsification: fal,
    uncertainty: unc,
  };

  const outDir = path.join(ROOT, 'artifacts', 'bench');
  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, 'nucleus.json'), JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), 'utf8');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, 'nucleus-report.md'), renderMarkdown(payload), 'utf8');

  console.log(` 总耗时 ${payload.meta.elapsedSec}s`);
  console.log(' 原始数据 → artifacts/bench/nucleus.json');
  console.log(' 报告     → artifacts/bench/nucleus-report.md');
  console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

function renderMarkdown(p) {
  const L = [];
  L.push('# 碳链通 · 核算算法与不确定度内核复算报告');
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> 生成时间：${p.meta.generatedAt}　耗时 ${p.meta.elapsedSec}s　蒙特卡洛 ${p.meta.iterations.toLocaleString()} 次　随机种子 ${p.meta.seed}`);
  L.push('>');
  L.push(`> ${p.meta.method}`);
  L.push('>');
  L.push(`> ${p.meta.determinism}`);
  L.push('');
  L.push(`**综合结论：${p.meta.overallPass ? '✅ 六项验证全部通过' : '⚠ 存在未通过项'}**`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('| # | 验证项 | 结果 |');
  L.push('| --- | --- | :---: |');
  L.push(`| ① | 台账自洽性（Tier1 vs Tier2） | ${p.ledgerConsistency.allConsistent ? '✅' : '❌'} |`);
  L.push(`| ② | 产品碳内部闭合（三分量） | ${p.pcfClosure.allPass ? '✅' : '❌'} |`);
  L.push(`| ③ | 组织碳核算（按企业 + 声明日历） | ✅ |`);
  L.push(`| ④ | 双轨包含性（组织碳 ⊇ 产品碳） | ${p.dualTrackReconcile.league.allPass ? '✅' : '❌'} |`);
  L.push(`| ⑤ | 判据可证伪性（负向注入） | ${p.falsification.allDetected ? '✅' : '❌'} |`);
  L.push(`| ⑥ | 不确定度互证（解析 vs 蒙特卡洛） | ${p.uncertainty.chain.crossCheckDiffPct < 5 && p.uncertainty.batch.crossCheckDiffPct < 5 ? '✅' : '⚠'} |`);
  L.push('');

  L.push('## 1. 台账自洽性：Tier 1 缺省法 vs Tier 2 参数展开法');
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 燃料 | Tier 1（缺省因子） | Tier 2（NCV×CC×OF×44/12） | 偏差 | 自洽 |');
  L.push('| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | :---: |');
  for (const r of p.ledgerConsistency.rows) {
    L.push(`| ${r.cn} | ${r.tier1} | ${r.tier2} | ${r.differencePct}% | ${r.consistent ? '✅' : '❌'} |`);
  }
  L.push('');
  L.push(`最大偏差 **${p.ledgerConsistency.maxDeviationPct}%**，结论：${p.ledgerConsistency.allConsistent ? '全部自洽 ✅' : '存在不一致 ❌'}`);
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${p.ledgerConsistency.note}`);
  L.push('');

  const c = p.pcfClosure;
  L.push('## 2. 产品碳内部闭合（Tier 1 强判据）');
  L.push('');
  L.push('判据：');
  L.push('');
  c.criteria.forEach((x) => L.push(`- ${x}`));
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 批次 | 产品 | 状态 | 批次总量 | Σ工序分摊 | 范围一+二 | 工序偏差 | 范围偏差 | 判定 |');
  L.push('| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | :---: |');
  c.rows.forEach((r) => {
    L.push(`| ${r.batchNo} | ${r.product} | ${r.status} | ${r.totalTco2e.toLocaleString()} | ${r.stageSum.toLocaleString()}`
      + ` | ${r.scopeSum.toLocaleString()} | ${r.stageDevPct}% | ${r.scopeDevPct}% | ${r.pass ? '✅' : '❌'} |`);
  });
  L.push('');
  L.push(`**${c.ok}/${c.total} 批次通过**，最大工序偏差 ${c.maxStageDevPct.toFixed(4)}%，最大范围偏差 ${c.maxScopeDevPct.toFixed(4)}%。`);
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${c.note}`);
  L.push('');

  const o = p.organizationCarbon;
  L.push('## 3. 组织碳核算（按企业 + 声明运行日历积分）');
  L.push('');
  L.push(`声明核算期 **${o.calendar.periodCn}**：${o.calendar.days} 日 × ${o.calendar.hoursPerDay} h`
    + ` × 在线率 ${(o.calendar.availability * 100).toFixed(1)}%（${o.calendar.availabilityFrom}）`
    + ` = **${o.calendar.hours.toFixed(1)} 运行小时**。`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 企业 | 行业 | 在网设备 | 有效计量点 | 期间组织碳(tCO₂e) | 范围一 | 范围二 |');
  L.push('| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |');
  o.perEnterprise.forEach((e) => {
    L.push(`| ${e.entShort} | ${e.industry} | ${e.devicesTotal} | ${e.devicesUsed}`
      + ` | ${e.metered ? e.periodTotal.toLocaleString() : '—（未接入计量）'}`
      + ` | ${e.metered ? e.scope1.toLocaleString() : '—'} | ${e.metered ? e.scope2.toLocaleString() : '—'} |`);
  });
  L.push(`| **合计** | — | ${o.devicesTotal} | ${o.devicesUsed} | **${o.periodTotal.toLocaleString()}** | ${o.scope1.toLocaleString()} | ${o.scope2.toLocaleString()} |`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('已接入企业的明细（活动数据 × 排放因子 = 期间排放）：');
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 企业 | 范围 | 排放源 | 瞬时读数 | 单位 | 运行小时 | 期间排放(tCO₂e) | 排放因子 |');
  L.push('| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |');
  o.perEnterprise.filter((e) => e.metered).forEach((e) => {
    e.items.forEach((i) => {
      L.push(`| ${e.entShort} | ${i.scope === 'SCOPE1' ? '范围一' : '范围二'} | ${i.cn}`
        + ` | ${i.quantity.toLocaleString()} | ${i.unit} | ${o.calendar.hours.toFixed(1)}`
        + ` | ${i.tco2ePeriod.toLocaleString()} | ${i.factor} |`);
    });
  });
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${o.note}`);
  L.push('');

  const r = p.dualTrackReconcile;
  L.push('## 4. 双轨对账（组织碳 ↔ 产品碳）');
  L.push('');
  L.push('**方法说明。** 组织碳刻画一家企业的**全部**排放；产品碳只覆盖**已上链存证的部分批次**。'
    + '因此正确的判据不是“两个数字相等”，而是：');
  L.push('');
  L.push('1. **包含性（硬约束）**：组织碳 ≥ Σ产品碳。组织碳必须是其产品碳之和的上界；违反即为数据打架。');
  L.push(`2. **可分摊空间**：E_alloc = 组织碳 × (1 − 辅助率 ${(r.auxShare * 100).toFixed(1)}% − 损耗率 ${(r.lossShare * 100).toFixed(1)}%)。`);
  L.push('3. **存证覆盖率**：ρ = Σ产品碳 / E_alloc。试点平台 ρ 偏小是正常的，如实报告而非调参凑闭合。');
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 企业 | 组织碳(tCO₂e) | Σ产品碳(tCO₂e) | 可分摊空间 | 未存证产出 | 覆盖率 ρ | 包含性 |');
  L.push('| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | :---: |');
  r.rows.forEach((x) => {
    if (!x.metered) {
      L.push(`| ${x.entName} | —（未接入计量） | ${x.pcfSum.toLocaleString()} | — | — | — | 跳过 |`);
    } else {
      L.push(`| ${x.entName} | ${x.orgTotal.toLocaleString()} | ${x.pcfSum.toLocaleString()}`
        + ` | ${x.allocatable.toLocaleString()} | ${x.residual.toLocaleString()} | ${x.coveragePct}%`
        + ` | ${x.pass ? '✅' : '❌'} |`);
    }
  });
  L.push(`| **联盟合计** | **${r.league.orgTotal.toLocaleString()}** | **${r.league.pcfSum.toLocaleString()}**`
    + ` | **${r.league.allocatable.toLocaleString()}** | — | **${r.league.coveragePct}%**`
    + ` | ${r.league.allPass ? '✅' : '❌'} |`);
  L.push('');
  r.rows.filter((x) => x.metered).forEach((x) => {
    L.push(`- **${x.entName}**：${x.verdict}`);
  });
  if (r.league.unmetered.length) {
    L.push('');
    L.push('未纳入对账的企业（显式单列，不用估算值填补）：');
    L.push('');
    r.league.unmetered.forEach((x) => L.push(`- ${x.entName}：${x.reason}`));
  }
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${r.note}`);
  L.push('');

  const f = p.falsification;
  L.push('## 5. 判据可证伪性验证（负向注入）');
  L.push('');
  L.push('如果一条判据在任何输入下都通过，它就不是判据。本节故意破坏数据链路，要求校验逻辑必须报警。');
  L.push('');
  L.push('| # | 注入内容 | 期望 | 实测观测 | 检出 |');
  L.push('| --- | --- | --- | --- | :---: |');
  f.cases.forEach((x) => {
    L.push(`| ${x.id} | ${x.inject} | ${x.expect} | ${x.observed} | ${x.detected ? '✅ 已检出' : '❌ 漏检'} |`);
  });
  L.push('');
  L.push(`**${f.detectedCount}/${f.total} 类注入被检出** —— 判据非空。`);
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${f.note}`);
  L.push('');

  const u = p.uncertainty;
  L.push('## 6. 不确定度传播：解析解 vs 蒙特卡洛（双向互证）');
  L.push('');
  L.push('### 6.1 乘性模型 —— 排放因子链（AD × NCV × CC × OF）');
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 输入项 | 相对标准不确定度 |');
  L.push('| --- | ---: |');
  u.chain.inputs.forEach((i) => L.push(`| ${i.cn} | ±${(i.sigmaRel * 100).toFixed(1)}% |`));
  L.push('');
  L.push(`- 解析解（√(Σσᵢ²)）：**±${(u.chain.analyticSigmaRel * 100).toFixed(2)}%**`);
  L.push(`- 蒙特卡洛（${u.iterations.toLocaleString()} 次）：**±${(u.chain.mcSigmaRel * 100).toFixed(2)}%**`);
  L.push(`- 两者相对偏差：**${u.chain.crossCheckDiffPct}%** → ${u.chain.crossCheckDiffPct < 5 ? '✅ 互证通过' : '⚠ 偏差偏大'}`);
  L.push(`- 分布分位（相对点估计）：P5 ${u.chain.p5}、P50 ${u.chain.p50}、P95 ${u.chain.p95}`);
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${u.chain.distribution.note}`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('一阶敏感性（方差贡献占比）：');
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 输入项 | 自身不确定度 | 方差贡献占比 |');
  L.push('| --- | ---: | ---: |');
  u.chain.sensitivity.forEach((s) => L.push(`| ${s.cn} | ±${(s.sigmaRel * 100).toFixed(1)}% | ${s.sharePct}% |`));
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${u.chain.recommendation}`);
  L.push('');

  L.push(`### 6.2 加性模型 —— 真实批次「${u.batch.batchNo} · ${u.batch.product}」`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 指标 | 值 |');
  L.push('| --- | ---: |');
  L.push(`| 点估计 | ${u.batch.central.toLocaleString()} ${u.batch.unit} |`);
  L.push(`| 抽样均值 | ${u.batch.mean.toLocaleString()} ${u.batch.unit} |`);
  L.push(`| 抽样标准差 | ${u.batch.sd.toLocaleString()} ${u.batch.unit} |`);
  L.push(`| 相对不确定度（解析） | ±${(u.batch.analyticSigmaRel * 100).toFixed(2)}% |`);
  L.push(`| 相对不确定度（蒙特卡洛） | ±${(u.batch.sigmaRel * 100).toFixed(2)}% |`);
  L.push(`| 互证相对偏差 | ${u.batch.crossCheckDiffPct}% |`);
  L.push(`| 95% 置信区间（均值 ±1.96σ） | ${u.batch.ci95.lo.toLocaleString()} ~ ${u.batch.ci95.hi.toLocaleString()} |`);
  L.push(`| 分位 | P5 ${u.batch.quantiles.p5.toLocaleString()} / P50 ${u.batch.quantiles.p50.toLocaleString()} / P95 ${u.batch.quantiles.p95.toLocaleString()} |`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 输入项 | 方差贡献占比 |');
  L.push('| --- | ---: |');
  u.batch.sensitivity.forEach((s) => L.push(`| ${s.cn} | ${s.sharePct}% |`));
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${u.batch.recommendation}`);
  L.push('');

  const g = u.gridMethod;
  L.push('### 6.3 口径差异：动态电网因子里程积分法 vs 年均因子法');
  L.push('');
  L.push('| 口径 | 结果(tCO₂) | 等效因子(tCO₂/MWh) |');
  L.push('| --- | ---: | ---: |');
  L.push(`| 动态法 Σ(电量_h × EF_h) | ${g.dynamic.toLocaleString()} | ${g.effectiveFactor} |`);
  L.push(`| 年均法 电量 × 年均因子 | ${g.flat.toLocaleString()} | ${g.annualFactor} |`);
  L.push(`| 差异 | ${g.difference.toLocaleString()}（${g.differencePct}%） | — |`);
  L.push('');
  L.push(`> ${g.interpretation}`);
  L.push('>');
  L.push('> 注意：这不是“哪个算错了”，而是**口径不同**。动态法反映真实时序，年均法是国家发布的合规口径。'
    + '本平台同时保留两者，正是为了让口径选择成为**可显式声明、可审计**的决定，而不是隐藏在代码里的默认值。');
  L.push('');

  L.push('## 7. 结论与局限');
  L.push('');
  L.push('**可以主张的结论：**');
  L.push('');
  L.push(`1. 台账与其宣称的 IPCC 算式**逐项自洽**（${p.ledgerConsistency.rows.length} 项燃料，最大偏差 ${p.ledgerConsistency.maxDeviationPct}%）。`);
  L.push(`2. 产品碳三分量（批次总量 / 范围一+二 / Σ工序分摊）**全部闭环**，最大偏差 ${Math.max(c.maxStageDevPct, c.maxScopeDevPct).toFixed(4)}%。`);
  L.push(`3. 组织碳按**可声明的运行日历**积分得到，${o.meteredCount} 家企业接入计量，期内合计 ${o.periodTotal.toLocaleString()} tCO₂e。`);
  L.push(`4. 双轨对账采用**包含性硬约束 + 覆盖率归因**，联盟级覆盖率 ${r.league.coveragePct}%，包含性全部成立。`);
  L.push(`5. 判据经**负向注入验证**：${f.total} 类故意破坏全部被检出（${f.detectedCount}/${f.total}），判据非空。`);
  L.push(`6. 不确定度传播**双向互证通过**：乘性模型解析 ${(u.chain.analyticSigmaRel * 100).toFixed(2)}% vs 抽样 ${(u.chain.mcSigmaRel * 100).toFixed(2)}%（偏差 ${u.chain.crossCheckDiffPct}%），`
    + `加性模型 ${(u.batch.analyticSigmaRel * 100).toFixed(2)}% vs ${(u.batch.sigmaRel * 100).toFixed(2)}%（偏差 ${u.batch.crossCheckDiffPct}%）。`);
  L.push(`7. 敏感性分析给出**可执行的降不确定度优先级**：先测准方差贡献最大的那一项，而不是平均用力。`);
  L.push(`8. 随机数固定种子（${p.meta.seed}），结果**跨机器可复现**，任何人可重跑核对。`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('**必须声明的局限：**');
  L.push('');
  L.push('1. 组织碳口径为“**已接入计量的设备子集**”，不等于企业全量排放边界；'
    + '未接入计量的能源介质（原料含碳、逸散、场内运输等）未计入，故该值是组织碳的**下界**。');
  L.push('2. 设备读数为**瞬时率**，乘运行小时积分是 Tier 1 近似；正式核算应按小时级历史读数做时间积分。');
  L.push(`3. 辅助用能率 ${(r.auxShare * 100).toFixed(1)}%、输配损耗率 ${(r.lossShare * 100).toFixed(1)}% 为**工程声明值**（traceLevel C），`
    + '接入企业历史台账后应替换为实测统计值，机制不变。');
  L.push('4. 双轨对账的覆盖率 ρ 反映**存证批次覆盖企业排放的比例**，它偏低说明试点期只存证了部分批次，'
    + '**不代表核算错误**；但它同时意味着“该企业的组织碳尚未被产品碳完整解释”。');
  L.push('5. 不确定度参数的 σ 取 IPCC 缺省区间代表值，**不是对本企业实测数据统计得到的真实分布**。');
  L.push('6. 蒙特卡洛假设各输入相互独立。若存在相关（如温度同时影响发热量与氧化率），'
    + '需引入相关系数矩阵，本平台当前未实现该扩展。');
  L.push('7. 蒸汽折算采用 1 t ≈ 2.76 GJ 的工程近似，且蒸汽排放因子属台账 C 级示例值。');
  L.push('');
  return L.join('\n');
}

main();
